jobs.title: Entry Level Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

PAE is an engineering and design firm that turns complex challenges into reality. By leveraging the latest technologies, we solve problems in unique ways, and our designs enable buildings and communities to be more resilient and efficient. PAE is trusted by our clients in every aspect of a project's lifespan, from idea to occupancy. We set ambitious goals backed by analysis to significantly conserve water and energy while balancing costs and long-term operational needs. As a B Corp, we measure success by the benefits our projects provide to our clients, our communities, and our planet. We embrace innovation, transparency, sustainability, and lifelong curiosity.

**What You'll Do**

* Develop relationships with project teams for effective communication
* Prepare project deliverables with attention to detail
* Develop knowledge of the construction industry
* Provide quality control for project documents for formatting, proofreading, and conformance with PAE's graphical standards
* Develop ability to facilitate construction administration activities
* Track deadlines, action items, RFIs, submittals
* Assist with project documentation, meeting setup and deliverables
* Utilize tools within the project quality management plan (QMP)

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or equivalent experience
* Experience in an administrative role ideally with an engineering firm or other subcontractor preferred
* Team player
* Reliable and flexible in style of work and able to maintain a positive attitude
* Strong written, verbal, interpersonal communication, and organizational skills
* Ability to multitask and switch between tasks
* Power user of Microsoft Office Suite
* Experience with Database Programs

**What We Offer**

* Hiring Base Salary Range: $55,300-$66,100 annual

  + This position is eligible for time and a half overtime pay

The base salary is one component of PAE’s competitive compensation package for employees. We take into consideration a variety of factors including but not limited to skills, abilities, experience, education, credentials, internal equity and geographic location in determining exact salary offered. At PAE, employees are eligible for annual compensation reviews based on performance and business needs. The above range represents PAE's good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting.

**In addition, PAE offers a comprehensive benefits package which includes the following:**

* Employer paid health insurance (medical, dental, vision)
* Annual 401k profit sharing based on company profit for the year and account contribution
* Professional development reimbursements including state registration and professional association dues
* Employer paid commuter/parking stipend
* Cell phone stipend
* Life insurance and disability benefits
* Hybrid work schedule
* Employee Assistance Program
* 9 paid holidays including an additional employee-selected day
* Paid time off for sick leave, family leave, community service, holidays and vacation
* To learn more about our comprehensive benefits package, visit https://www.pae-engineers.com/careers/benefits. This information is provided per the Equal Pay Act

**Our commitment to pay equity**

PAE is a JUST label certified company; we demonstrate JUST label requirements within pay equity. Pay scales should meet or exceed applicable legislated wage requirements and industry standards and compensate, on the same basis, all individuals performing the same or similar work and work of equal value. We are committed to the principle of pay equity – paying employees equitably for substantially similar work. To learn more about pay equity and our commitments to equitable business practices, you may view our JUST label certification here: Living Future: Just Label Certification.

To find out more visit our website.

**What We’re Made Of**

Founded in 1967, PAE is a leading sustainable engineering and consulting firm on a mission to deliver clean air, energy, and water for all. We specialize in mechanical, electrical, and plumbing engineering, building performance analysis, technology design, and lighting design (LUMA). PAE designs some of the nation's highest-performing and most regenerative built environments across the U.S., from Living Buildings to all-electric buildings and beyond. Learn more at pae-engineers.com.

Our portfolio includes over 100 LEED Platinum projects as well as dozens of projects that have either achieved or are pursuing the Living Building Challenge, Passive House, Architecture 2030, Carbon Neutral, Net Zero Energy, and Net Zero Water.

**Fine Print**

If candidates without a previously signed recruiter fee agreement are submitted, PAE reserves the right to engage with and hire those candidate(s) without any obligation financial or otherwise to the recruiter or agency.

In order to provide equal employment and advancement opportunities to all individuals, employment decisions at PAE will be based on merit, qualifications and abilities. PAE does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, religion, gender (sex), national origin, age, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, physical characteristics historically associated with race, disability, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

PAE will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities unless doing so would result in an undue hardship. jobs.title: Housing Counselor (Program Coordinator I)
jobs.description:
**Exciting Career Opportunity!**
  
  
**Please note that applications will only be accepted Wednesday, November 25, 2026 through Thursday, December 10, 2026 at 11:59 pm.**  
  
The City of Pasadena is seeking a Housing Counselor to join the newly created Rent Stabilization Department. Housing Counselors play a crucial role in providing tenants, landlords, and other stakeholders information about their rights and responsibilities as they relate to the Pasadena Fair and Equitable Housing Charter Article XVIII and other relevant laws.
  
  
In this role, Housing Counselors will:

* Empower tenants, landlords, and others to understand their rights and responsibilities under Pasadena's rent stabilization law (Charter Article XVIII) and other relevant laws.
* Provide clear and neutral information on topics like rent increases and eviction protections.
* Help tenants make informed decisions by presenting options without taking sides or giving legal advice.
* Connect tenants with legal resources when needed.
* Simplify Rent Stabilization processes for everyone by assisting with requests for mediations, petitions, and accessing other city services.

**IDEAL CANDIDATE**
  
The *ideal candidate* will have knowledge of housing policies and/or landlord-tenant law. A key function of this position is to serve as a neutral party, so excellent communication skills, diplomacy, and relationship building are key to success. Strong organizational skills, action and results focus, and critical thinking skills are also required.
  
  
This is an exciting career opportunity to be part of a team of professionals that will help establish and flourish this new city department providing vital services to our Pasadena community. Come be a part of our team!

**Essential Functions**
-----------------------

The major responsibilities of this position are listed.

* Provides housing counseling and technical support to the public regarding the Pasadena Fair and Equitable Housing Charter Article XVIII and other relevant laws which includes responding to telephone inquiries, emails, providing services in appointments (in-person & virtual) and engaging in other public information activities as directed.
* Works closely with and provides technical assistance, directly or through subordinate staff, to the Rent Stabilization Department, and community and neighborhood-based committees and programs.
* Compiles and analyzes data; prepares written and oral reports for the Rent Stabilization Department, Hearing Officers, and other senior staff on a variety of development policies and programs.
* Works with the program supervisor, other City departments and public agencies, boards and commissions, and the private sector in developing a comprehensive and integrated approach to the administration of the local rent stabilization laws and regulations.
* Works with various community groups and membership organizations to encourage an interest in program goals and projects.
* Organizes special community education programs, workshops, conferences, meetings, and speaker's bureaus; advises departmental personnel on the use of educational materials and techniques and the use of community resources.
* Represents the Rent Stabilization Department at meetings, events, and in contacts with other agencies, commissions, business and community groups, and members of the public.
* Provides technical assistance to others on the Charter and related regulations; may supervise support staff on a project or regular basis.
* Utilizes customer service software to create/update case management notes and generate reports tracking key metrics including extensive use of excel.
* Performs related duties as assigned.

**Qualification Guidelines**
----------------------------

**COMPETENCIES**
  
The following list represents the core competencies needed for success in this position.

* **Action & Results Focus** - Initiating tasks and focusing on accomplishment.
* **Attention to Detail** - Focusing on the details of work content, work steps, and final work products.
* **Professional Integrity & Ethics** - Displaying honesty, adherence to principles, and personal accountability.
* **Oral Communication** - Engaging effectively in dialogue.
* **Customer Focus** - Attending to the needs and expectations of customers.
* **Relationship Building** - Establishing rapport and maintaining mutually productive relationships.
* **Critical Thinking** - Analytically and logically evaluating information, propositions, and claims.
* **Legal & Regulatory Navigation** - Understanding, interpreting, and ensuring compliance with laws and regulations.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**
  
Any combination of education and/or experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary for acceptable job performance would qualify. Example combinations include: bachelor's degree in sociology, political science, public policy, public administration, psychology, social science, or a closely related field and two years of professional-level experience in developing and/or delivering housing or legal service programs. Individuals with rental housing advocacy and counseling experience will be deemed most qualified.
  
  
**SELECTION PROCESS**
  
The selection process may consist of a training and experience evaluation, interview panel, and/or department-level interviews.
  
  
**VACANCY INFORMATION**
  
The resulting eligibility list from this recruitment may be used to fill similar vacancies in the future.
  
  
Candidates selected for this position are subject to a one year probationary work period.

**Special Requirements**
------------------------

Must have or obtain a Class C California driver's license and a satisfactory driving record, as they may be required for some assignments.

CSUDH, Toro Auxiliary Partners
  
  
Full-Time | Non-Exempt | Benefited | Onsite |
  
  
About CSUDH Toro Auxiliary Partners
  
The California State University, Dominguez Hills (CSUDH) Toro Auxiliary Partners was established in 1968 to serve as a strategic partner of the university. The Auxiliary provides essential services, supports innovative programs, and enhances initiatives that are integral to the university’s educational mission.
  
  
About CSU Dominguez Hills
  
Founded in 1960, CSU Dominguez Hills is one of 23 campuses in the California State University system. The university is recognized for its rich diversity and serves as a vital educational hub for the South Bay region of Los Angeles County. Its mission is to foster academic excellence and community engagement in a dynamic, metropolitan environment.
  
  
Position Summary
  
Under the direct supervision of the Associate Director, the Program Coordinator I assists with the implementation and coordination of the federally funded TRIO Educational Talent Search (ETS) Program, serving low-income and potential first-generation college students within the Inglewood Unified School District. The Program Coordinator I carries out assigned program activities in accordance with established policies, procedures, and program requirements and receives guidance and direction from the Director in planning, implementing, and evaluating program services.
  
  
The Program Coordinator I provides academic and career advising to participants and assists with college access, academic support, career pathway exploration, financial aid assistance, recruitment, Individualized Service Plan (ISP) development, data collection and tracking, and program activities. Under the direction of the Director, the position supports participants in achieving academic and career goals, including secondary school persistence and graduation, completion of rigorous programs of study, postsecondary enrollment or entry into Registered Apprenticeships, and attainment of postsecondary degrees and credentials.
  
  
The Program Coordinator assists with program data collection, recordkeeping, reporting, and monitoring of participant progress to support program accountability and compliance with federal TRIO requirements. The position may also assist with the coordination and monitoring of academic tutors and/or student staff, as assigned, and perform other program-related duties under the direction of the Director.
  
  
**The position supports the grant's Absolute Priority:** Expanding Education Choice, with responsibility for Absolute Priority B (pre-apprenticeships and Registered Apprenticeships) and Absolute Priority C (programs or coursework leading to in-demand, industry-recognized postsecondary credentials).

* Inglewood High School: 300 Students

Position Information
  
Employment at Toro Auxiliary Partners is on an at-will basis. It can be terminated by either an employee or Toro Auxiliary Partners at any time with or without cause or advanced notice. Permanent status can neither be obtained nor granted. This position is full-time, nonexempt, benefited, plus employer-sponsored health, dental, vision, life insurance, retirement, and sick/vacation pay.
  
  
**Hourly Rate:** $25.00 (3 available positions)

Recruitment & Outreach
  
  

* Coordinate recruitment and outreach efforts at Inglewood HS and City Honors HS to maintain the approved annual participant caseload.
* Conduct classroom presentations, parent/guardian workshops, informational sessions, and outreach activities communicating ETS eligibility, services, objectives, and college/career pathway opportunities.
* Review applications and supporting documentation; verify participant eligibility; support participant
* selection and enrollment in accordance with federal TRIO requirements. Submit documents to the Associate Director for final approval of participants.
* Under the direction of the Director, maintain collaborative relationships with school administrators, counselors, teachers, school CTE liaisons, community organizations, workforce partners, and referral partners.

* Maintain an active caseload and develop, implement, and monitor Individualized Service Plans (ISPs) for assigned participants.

* Monitor GPA, course completion, A-G/Rigorous Secondary School Program of Study progress, attendance, graduation requirements, and postsecondary preparation milestones.

jobs.title: RN Response Team Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Summary and Responsibilities**

As our Response Team Program Coordinator RN (RTPC) within the Clinical Response/Code Team, you will be a highly skilled and experienced individual responsible for providing immediate assessment, intervention, and stabilization to patients exhibiting signs of clinical deterioration or experiencing a medical emergency (e.g., Code Blue, Rapid Response).  
  
Every day you will serve as a critical resource for the hospital, working collaboratively with physicians, other nurses, and interdisciplinary team members to improve patient outcomes and prevent adverse events. You will utilize advanced clinical judgment, critical thinking skills, and expertise in resuscitation and advanced life support to provide optimal patient care in high-pressure situations, ensuring timely and effective responses to urgent medical needs.  
  
To be successful in this role, you will demonstrate exceptional clinical expertise in emergency and critical care, superior critical thinking ability, and the capacity to lead and collaborate effectively under pressure. Your commitment to rapid assessment, decisive intervention, and continuous improvement in patient outcomes will be fundamental in mitigating adverse events and maintaining the highest standards of patient safety.

Clinical Expertise and Leadership:  

* + Serves as a clinical resource and mentor for other nurses, providing guidance and support in the management of critically ill patients.  
  + Maintains current knowledge of best practices in critical care, resuscitation, and emergency medicine.  
  + Participates in the development and implementation of policies and procedures related to rapid response, code blue, and all other emergency code responses across the hospital campus  
  + Identifies opportunities to improve patient safety and quality of care.  
  + Collaborates with department leaders, staff, and quality/ risk to complete timeline reviews and data abstraction  
  + Participates in hospital committees and initiatives related to critical care and emergency preparedness.  
  + Develops Education/ training based on trends/ opportunities for clinical knowledge share. Collaborates with education / simulation lab team to deliver education.
Communication and Collaboration:  
* + Communicates effectively with physicians, nurses, and other members of the healthcare team.  
  + Provides clear and concise reports to the attending physician and other relevant providers.  
  + Maintains a professional and respectful demeanor in all interactions.  
  + Collaborates with other departments (e.g., respiratory therapy, pharmacy) to ensure optimal patient care.
* Responds to all clinical emergency calls in the hospital and surrounding designated areas.
Code Blue Response:  
* + Responds immediately to Code Blue activations throughout the hospital.  
  + Assumes a leadership role in the resuscitation effort, coordinating team members and ensuring adherence to established protocols.  
  + Will lead and or participate in post-code debriefings to identify areas for improvement in the resuscitation process.  
  + Performs advanced life support measures, including chest compressions, ventilation, defibrillation, and medication administration, according to ACLS guidelines.  
  + Monitors patient response to interventions and adjusts treatment as needed.  
  + Documents all events during the Code Blue, including interventions, medications administered, and patient outcomes.
Code OB / Code Crimson / Code White:  
* + Assumes a leadership role in the overseeing the coordination of team members, ensuring adherence to established protocols and assisting with the escalation process as needed.  
  + Will lead and or participate in post-code debriefings to identify areas for improvement in the resuscitation process.
Rapid Response:  
* + Conducts rapid and thorough assessments of patients exhibiting signs of clinical deterioration (e.g., changes in vital signs, altered mental status, respiratory distress).  
  + Initiates appropriate interventions based on assessment findings, including oxygen therapy, medication administration, fluid resuscitation, and airway management.  
  + Collaborates with the primary care team to develop and implement a plan of care to stabilize the patient and prevent further deterioration.  
  + Provides education and support to bedside nurses on early recognition of clinical deterioration and appropriate interventions.  
  + Documents all assessments, interventions, and patient responses accurately and completely in the electronic health record.

**Job Requirements**

Required

* Bachelors Of Nursing, upon hire and
* Registered Nurse: CA, upon hire and
* Basic Life Support - CPR, upon hire and
* Advanced Cardiac Life Support, upon hire and
* Pediatric Advanced Life Support, upon hire and
* Critical RN Adult/Neonatal/Pediatric/Acute, within 6 - months and
* Certified EKG Tech, upon hire and
* Fire Safety, upon hire and

Preferred

* Masters Of Nursing, upon hire
* Neonatal Resuscitation Program, upon hire

Where You'll Work

Founded in 1887, Dignity Health - California Hospital Medical Center is a 318-bed, acute care, nonprofit hospital located in downtown Los Angeles, California. Serving over 100,000 patients annually, the hospital offers a full complement of services including a Level II Trauma Center, Level III NICU, heart care, women’s health, and a family birth center. Additionally, California Hospital Medical Center has been recognized as an LGBTQ+ Healthcare Equality Leader by the Human Rights Campaign Foundation. jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Description**

Under direction of the Principal Investigator (PI) and the CTU/CRS Manager, the employee is to perform research activities directly related to HIV clinical trials in the Center for Clinical AIDS Research and Education (CARE Center) including but not limited to the AIDS Clinical Trials Group (ACTG), HIV Prevention Trials Network (HPTN), HIV Vaccine Trials Network (HVTN), and COVID19 Prevention Trials Network (CoVPN). The incumbent will be directly responsible for assisting with fast-paced implementation of HIV trials; assigned start up and closure of clinical research studies, participant registration, randomization, compliance, participant recruitment, enrollment, data management and education as related to each protocol. Document signs, symptoms and other changes for reporting to PIs as appropriate with research participants; assist in report preparation for IRB, IBC, CTSI/CTRC, radiology and other ancillary departments and/or committees. Participate in quality assurance activities for studies across the research unit. Interact with study monitors regarding protocol management and resolution of study queries. Work with outreach team in expanding recruitment efforts for HIV trials. Assist in drafting general standard operating procedures for CARE Research, as well as study-specific standard operating procedures, source documents, and forms. Assist with all aspects of preparation for and conduct of regulatory audits. Other tasks as assigned.

Hourly salary range: $38.19 - $61.45

  
Pay range: $38.19 - $61.45 an hour  
  
**Qualifications**

Required:

* Bachelor's degree in related area and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimally 2+ years of previous study coordination or clinical research coordination experience
* Interpersonal skills to effectively communicate information in a timely, professional manner and establish and maintain cooperative and effective working relationships with students, staff, faculty, external collaborators and administration and to work as a member of a team.
* Ability to effectively communicate to and interact with patients in a compassionate and kind manner.
* Ability to set priorities and complete ongoing tasks with competing deadlines, with frequent interruptions, to meet the programmatic and department needs, while complying with applicable University policies and federal and state regulations.
* Analytical skills to assess clinical research protocols and regulatory requirements, define problems, formulate logical solutions, develop alternative solutions, make recommendations, and initiate corrective actions.
* Close attention to detail to ensure accuracy in a fast-paced, fluctuating workload environment.
* Organization skills to create and maintain administrative and regulatory files effectively as well as independently balance the various tasks to ensure deadlines are met.
* Demonstrated proficiency with Adobe and Microsoft suite software, especially Excel, to perform daily tasks efficiently and accurately.
* A learning and professional growth mentality so that new software tools, systems, and processes can be adopted quickly and efficiently
* Working knowledge of clinical research concepts, policies and procedures, and human safety protection regulations and laws.
* Knowledge of and experience working with a variety of local and external IRBs, scientific review and other research committees, national cooperative group sponsors, industry sponsors, federal and foundation funding organizations, etc.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively establish rapport, building collaborative relationships, and communicate complex concepts and ideas in an easy-to-understand manner.
* Ability to adapt to changing job demands and priorities, remain flexible including working flexible hours to accommodate research deadlines.
* High degree of concentration and focus in a work environment that contains distracting stimuli, competing deadlines, and work delegated by more than one individual
* Availability to work in more than one environment, travelling to various clinic sites, meetings, conferences, etc.

---------------

As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.  
Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help Media & Entertainment Enterprise-level customers gain the best value and service from AWS? AWS Enterprise Support, Technical Account Managers (TAM) support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Media, AI/ML, Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application-level Services, Networking, Serverless, Deployment, Security and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to Fortune 500 enterprises.
  
  
The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, SageMaker, Bedrock, DynamoDB, RDS, Lambda, CloudFront, Elemental Media Services, and many more.  
  
Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade-offs, support and risk management.  
  
You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

jobs.description:
ABOUT 8FLEET

8Fleet is hiring! We are a fast-growing technology and logistics company building the operational backbone for rideshare fleets, both driver-operated and autonomous. We run 24/7 operations with full-time drivers, a managed fleet of vehicles and a team that keeps it all moving. As we grow in Los Angeles, we are building out our local team.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an Operations Coordinator, based in Los Angeles, to keep our market running every day. You will keep driver shifts covered, vehicles assigned and ready, and the team working from the same information. When something breaks at 6 a.m., you are the person who already knows and is fixing it.

This is an on-site, hands-on role for someone who likes a fast pace, thinks in systems and enjoys being the person everyone relies on. You will work closely with Los Angeles market leadership and help build the processes and reporting the team uses as the market grows. Strong coordinators here grow into analyst and operations management roles.

SCHEDULE

Full-time, salaried, on-site in Los Angeles. This role supports a 24/7 operation, so some early mornings, evenings or weekends are expected.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Own Daily Coverage: Build and manage driver schedules and shift coverage, fill gaps quickly and keep vehicles earning.
* Keep Vehicles on the Road: Coordinate vehicle assignments, handoffs and availability with the Fleet Support and Maintenance teams so downtime stays low.
* Be the Operational Hub: Be the first point of contact for drivers and supervisors on day-to-day issues, and route what you cannot solve to the right owner fast.
* Run the Numbers: Track daily metrics such as coverage, utilization, attendance and vehicle status, and turn them into clear updates for leadership.
* Fix What Slows Us Down: Spot recurring problems, document how things should work and help put better processes and tools in place.
* Support Growth: Help with onboarding logistics, driver communications, supplies and site needs as we grow the Los Angeles market.

QUALIFICATIONS

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

**PRODUCTION COORDINATOR (STARSHIELD)**

Starshield leverages SpaceX's Starlink technology and launch capability to support national security efforts. While Starlink is designed for consumer and commercial use, Starshield is designed for government use, with an initial focus on three areas: Earth observation, communications, and hosted payloads. Designed to meet diverse mission requirements, Starshield satellites are capable of integrating a wide variety of payloads, offering unique versatility to users. With the proven ability to iterate rapidly, SpaceX's unique full-stack approach in developing end-to-end systems, from launch vehicles to user terminals, enables the deployment of capabilities at scale with unprecedented speed. Starshield's proliferated low-Earth orbit architecture provides inherent resiliency and constant connectivity to on-orbit assets, while SpaceX's proven rapid launch capability provides expedient and economical access to space.

The Production Coordinator is a linchpin position within our Starshield team. This role serves as a liaison between input and output organizations to ensure that components and assemblies flow smoothly through the production area and meet stringent deadlines and quality standards.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Monitor, track, and move parts as required through the production flow to ensure timely delivery to the next production location

* Coordinate off-site processing of parts to ensure on-time delivery as required
* Work with the planning, procurement, engineering, and production teams to ensure MRP/ERP data stays clean and accurate
* Assist with the resolution of incorrect system data that is driving inappropriate demand or schedules, or that could result in a general failure
* Analyze available data and develop metrics as required to drive optimal results
* Work with production personnel to ensure metric goals are understood
* Update and use the target management system to drive results as applicable
* Work with production supervisors and managers to ensure all metrics-driven action requirements are completed
* Develop and maintain reports to highlight needs, deliverables, and constraints as required for internal and customer use
* Communicate part status and estimated completion dates to leadership weekly
* Assist production leadership and project teams with action item updates as required
* Support the logistics process through the innovative staging of workflow as required
* Manage material certifications as required, and prevent the use of uncertified materials
* Support production and inventory personnel with return-to-stock and inventory purge actions
* Support purchase requisition creation for scheduled contract work as required
* Organize and maintain the physical and electronic library for production-related tooling and the calibration database as required
* Support projects or productivity development activities within assigned production cells
* Support assigned production cells with work order management activities as required

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* High school diploma or equivalency certificate
* 1+ years of experience supporting administrative processes

**PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Strong computer skills and familiarity with the full Microsoft Office suite
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience organizing files and documents
* Knowledge of MRP/ERP systems
* Experience in aerospace, automotive, semiconductor, or electronics manufacturing environments
* SQL and Tableau experience
* APICS certification

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Must be willing to work all shifts, overtime, and/or weekends as needed. Estimated 1st shift hours: 5:00 a.m.–2:30 p.m.
* Able to lift up to 25 lbs. unassisted
* Able to stand for extended periods, 8 hours minimum

**COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:**  
  
Pay Range:  
Level 1: $22.00 - $24.50  
Level 2: $24.00 - $27.50  
Level 3: $27.00 - $31.00

  

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. **About HYH America**

HYH America Inc. is a U.S.-based subsidiary of hy Co., Ltd., a South Korean leader in fermented dairy, functional beverages, and health-focused nutrition with over 50 years of innovation. This role requires both strong execution and strategic thinking, with responsibility for managing content, engagement, and performance while contributing to overall social media strategy. **1. Social Media Strategy & Channel Management**

jobs.title: DESIGNER AND PROJECT COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
**Olczak Group · Berkeley, CA · Full time, in office, 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM · $45 to $55 per hour**

Read this first. This role is in person at our Berkeley studio, five days a week, 8:30 to 5:30 with an hour for lunch. It is paid hourly. If that works for you, keep reading.

We are a licensed architecture practice and a licensed general contractor under one roof, with our own build team. Our work is high end residential in the Bay Area: ground up new homes, gut renovations, and remodels, with budgets that run into the millions. See our work at olczakgroup.com and olczakbuild.com. This seat is two jobs in one. You are the studio's Revit and visualization expert, producing the models, drawing sets, and images behind every project. You are also the coordinator who keeps project information moving so our Project Leads can lead. It is also the seat we promote from. Within your first year you will lead a small project of your own, such as a kitchen, a bath, or a backyard studio, with a Project Lead signing off at each gate.

**What you will do**

Design and production

* Build and maintain the Revit model for each project, from existing conditions through construction documents, under the direction of a Project Lead.
* Produce drawing sets that pass our written quality review the first time.
* Own the studio's Revit standards: templates, families, and the habits that keep models clean.
* Create the renderings and visualizations we use to present designs to clients.
* Contribute design work of your own: studies, options, and details.
* Measure and document existing conditions in the field.

Coordination

* Keep the logs current every day: submittals, RFIs, client selections, and bid tracking.
* Assemble bid packages from our templates, send them to subcontractors, chase the responses, and file them where they belong.
* Take meeting notes, turn them into action items the same day, and follow up until each one is closed.
* Track orders and lead times so nothing lands late on site.
* Support permit submittals: forms, sheets, and the response to comments.
* Keep project files organized to our written standard.

**What the work is really like**

This seat is about 65 percent design and production and 35 percent coordination, and both parts count. One day you are deep in a model. The next you are sending the third email and updating a log. People who want only to design will resent the follow up. People who want only to coordinate will not keep up in Revit. We are looking for the person who likes both, and who wants to run a project of their own.

**Who this fits**

* You hold a degree in architecture.
* You have five or more years of production experience in Revit, and you are the person others ask when a model breaks.
* You produce client ready renderings in V-Ray and Enscape, and your portfolio shows it.
* You have a designer's eye and can develop an idea into a buildable detail.
* You are organized in a way other people can see: your files, your notes, your inbox.
* You communicate before you are asked. If something will be late, we hear it from you first.

**What you get**

* $45 to $55 per hour, with overtime paid.
* A defined path. You lead your first small project within your first year, and we review your progress toward Designer Builder, the next seat up, at twelve months, against written criteria.
* Daily exposure to both design and construction, in the same room as the people doing each.
* Written standards for nearly everything you will be asked to do.
* PTO on accrual basis (per hour worked) for a maximum of 10 days per calendar year @ 40 hrs / week.
* Opportunities for continuing education in building science, architecture, materials, and detailing
* A positive work culture grounded in mutual respect, accountability, and integrity
* Employer subsidized healthcare benefits

**How to apply**

Email your resume and portfolio to careers@olczakgroup.com. The portfolio should include drawing sheets and renderings you produced yourself, with your role stated on each. Use the subject line "Designer and Project Coordinator" followed by your name, and tell us the earliest date you could start. In the body of the email, answer these two questions in 150 words or fewer each:

1.What is the most disorganized project or situation you have inherited, and what did you do first?

2.What is one system you built to keep track of things, and how do you know it works?

Applications without both answers will not be reviewed. Finalists complete a short paid Revit exercise.

Olczak Group is an equal opportunity employer.

Pay: $45.00 - $55.00 per hour

ABOUT THE ROLE  
We are looking for an organized, guest-focused Event Coordinator to manage private dining, group reservations, and special events at Colibrí. You will be the main point of contact for event guests from first inquiry through the final toast, working closely with the kitchen, front-of-house team, and management to deliver memorable events that run smoothly and profitably.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Sales and Guest Communication

* Respond promptly to event inquiries by phone, email, and online platforms, ideally within 24 hours.
* Conduct site tours and consultations with prospective clients.
* Prepare event proposals, menus, pricing, and contracts, and follow up to convert inquiries into bookings.
* Collect deposits and final payments in line with company policy.
* Build relationships with repeat clients, local businesses, and community organizations to grow event sales.

Event Planning and Execution

* Coordinate all event details, including menus, beverage packages, timelines, floor plans, décor, and A/V needs.
* Create and distribute Banquet Event Orders (BEOs) to the kitchen, bar, and service teams in advance of each event.
* Hold pre-event briefings with staff and confirm final guest counts and dietary needs with clients.
* Be on site to oversee setup, guest arrival, and service flow, and resolve issues in real time.
* Coordinate with outside vendors such as florists, musicians, and rental companies as needed.

Administration and Reporting

* Maintain the event calendar and booking records in our reservation and POS systems.
* Track event revenue, covers, and pipeline, and share regular reports with management.
* Ensure events meet budget and food and beverage cost targets.
* Gather client feedback after each event and share insights with the team.

Team and Brand

* Work closely with the General Manager, Executive Chef, and Bar Manager to align event menus with Colibrí’s concept and standards.
* Support group-wide activations, holiday programming, and seasonal promotions.
* Represent Colibrí and the Buen Rallo brand professionally at all times.

QUALIFICATIONS

* 2+ years of experience in event coordination, private dining sales, or restaurant/hospitality management.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple events at once.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; bilingual English/Spanish strongly preferred.
* Comfortable with sales conversations, negotiating, and upselling.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace or Microsoft Office; experience with Toast, Perfect Venue, OpenTable, or similar platforms is a plus.
* Working knowledge of food and beverage, including menu pairings and dietary considerations.

* Ability to stand for extended periods and lift up to 30 lbs.

* Competitive pay with.

* Dining discounts across all Buen Rallo restaurants.
* Opportunities for growth within a multi-concept restaurant group.

**About Pallet**

Pallet is building AI Agents to transform the physical economy, a $12 trillion global TAM. We've raised $50M from top investors, including General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures.

Our mission is to increase the efficiency of the global supply chain by automating the manual workflows that slow supply chain teams down. Our flagship platform provides end-to-end visibility, and control.

As companies across the physical economy look to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep supply chain expertise and cutting-edge AI capabilities, we're positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy.

Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology.

**$100,000 - $140,000**  
Full-time / Onsite (5 days/week) / ~25% Travel

**About The Role**

As a Field & Event Marketing Manager at Pallet, you will be on the front lines of how we show up in the market, from major industry conferences to intimate executive dinners, customer roundtables, and targeted field campaigns.

This role owns the planning and execution of high-impact programs that create demand, deepen customer relationships, build brand awareness, and directly influence pipeline. That includes choosing the right events, coordinating logistics, partnering with Sales on pre- and post-event outreach, creating memorable attendee experiences, and measuring what worked.

The ideal candidate is equal parts creative campaign thinker, operational project manager, and revenue partner. They thrive in fast-moving environments, bring structure to complexity, and get excited about turning ideas into programs that sales teams actually use and prospects remember.

**This role is for you if**

* Sees field marketing as a growth engine, not just an events function.
* Loves the full lifecycle: identifying the right opportunities, building the strategy, executing the details, and measuring what actually worked.
* Can move between big-picture strategy and hands-on execution, from building an event plan to digging through attendee lists, pipeline data, and conversion metrics.
* Takes ownership, figures things out proactively, and jumps in wherever needed.
* Cares about business outcomes and can connect field marketing work to pipeline, revenue, relationships, and broader company goals.
* Thinks outside the box and gets excited about unconventional, guerrilla, and sometimes absurd marketing ideas that break through the noise.

**This role is likely not for you if**

* Sees field marketing primarily as attending events, hosting dinners, and managing on-site logistics.
* Enjoys the experiential side of events but not the planning, targeting, data analysis, and follow-through behind them.
* Prefers to own one narrow piece of a program rather than taking responsibility from strategy through execution and measurement.
* Defaults to traditional marketing playbooks over experimenting with unconventional ways to reach people.
* Prefers structured guidance and established processes over independently navigating ambiguity.

**What You'll Do**

* Execute up to three field programs per week, managing end-to-end planning through post-program analysis, including events, dinners, activations, and other creative campaigns
* Develop creative out-of-home, ABM, and guerrilla marketing campaigns that reach target accounts in unexpected ways and break through the noise
* Manage and optimize event budgets across booths, sponsorships, travel, swag, and side events
* Partner with sales and marketing to align on goals, targeting, and execution, including building custom outreach for each campaign
* Identify high-impact events aligned with Pallet's ICP to maximize ROI and pipeline
* Analyze project performance to measure success and improve future programs
* Build and maintain scalable playbooks and templates for repeatable execution
* Share post-program insights and metrics to drive alignment and continuous improvement

* 2-5 years of experience in field marketing, sales, marketing, events, or a related role.
* Proven ability to independently manage end-to-end events within a 7-30 day turnaround, ideally having managed 20+ events per year.
* Strong project management and organizational skills with an eye for detail.
* Experience managing event budgets and vendor relationships.
* Ability to analyze program performance data and communicate actionable insights.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally.
* Ability to remain calm under pressure and troubleshoot issues in real time.
* Comfort proactively approaching, engaging, and building relationships with executives at all levels in event settings.

**Nice To Have**

* Familiarity with B2B SaaS or enterprise software
* Experience working closely with sales teams

Enrollment and Marketing Coordinator

JOB DESCRIPTION

A Catholic School Enrollment and Marketing Coordinator drives student recruitment, retention, and brand awareness by managing admissions processes, fostering community relationships, and executing marketing campaigns. Responsibilities include organizing recruitment events, maintaining databases, and creating content that promotes the school’s mission to prospective families.

School Overview

Saint James is a K-8 Catholic elementary school nestled between Noe Valley and the Mission. Centrally located in the City, St. James lives within two of the most dynamic and vibrant neighborhoods. St. James School serves children of families of diverse cultural ethnic, and socioeconomic backgrounds with all services afforded by the Archdiocese of San Francisco. Empowered by Jesus and His teachings, we accept the responsibility to help develop the gifts and talents of students, parents, and staff alike.

This position reports to the Principal, and is supported by existing clerical staff, a Vision of Hope mentor, and ongoing professional development opportunities. Additionally, the school and Vision of Hope community will be a source of volunteer assistance in carrying out specific tasks associated with enrollment and/or marketing. Specific job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Key Responsibilities ● Enrollment Management: Drive inquiries, manage the application process, conduct school tours, and organize promotional events. ● Marketing & Communication: Develop and distribute all promotional materials, flyers, and brochures. ● Student Retention: Develop and execute strategies to retain current families and increase re-enrollment rates. ● Community Outreach: Build relationships with local parishes, feeder schools, and community stakeholders to promote the school. Travel to community events, centers, and feeder schools to build a prospect pipeline. ● Data & Strategy: Maintain accurate prospective family databases, provide monthly reports to administration and Vision of Hope, and ensure marketing ROI.

Qualifications

jobs.title: Lead Conversion Specialist & Social Media Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Lead Conversion Specialist & Social Media Coordinator**

**Position Overview** Be Clinical is hiring a Lead Conversion Specialist to own the prospect-to-patient process and manage our social media presence. This is an onsite role: about 80% of your time will be spent converting inbound and outbound leads into booked consultations and paying patients, and the remaining 20% will focus on growing Be Clinical's social media channels. The ideal candidate is warm and persuasive on the phone, organized under a high lead volume, and has a strong eye for on-brand clinical/aesthetic content. You will be responsible for both creating the social media content that creates leads but also converting them into consultations.

**Position Split** 80% – Lead Conversion 20% – Social Media Management

**Key Responsibilities**

*Lead Conversion (80%)*

* Respond promptly to every inbound lead (web forms, phone, email, SMS, DMs) with industry-leading response times.
* Qualify prospective patients, understand their goals and concerns, and guide them toward the appropriate treatment or consultation.
* Book, confirm, and reduce no-shows for consultations and treatments through structured follow-up cadences (call, text, email).
* Re-engage aged, cold, and unconverted leads through targeted outreach and win-back campaigns.
* Maintain accurate, up-to-date records of every lead, stage, and outcome in the CRM.
* Communicate pricing, packages, financing options, and pre/post-care information clearly and compliantly.
* Partner with clinical staff to ensure smooth handoffs from sales consult to treatment.
* Share lead quality feedback, common objections, and conversion insights with marketing.
* Hit or exceed monthly targets for consultations booked, show rate, and revenue converted.

*Social Media Management (20%)*

* Plan, create, schedule, and publish content across Instagram, TikTok, Instagram, and other relevant channels.
* Maintain a content calendar aligned with promotions, new treatments, seasonal campaigns, and provider spotlights.
* Capture and edit short-form video (Reels, TikToks) and photos in-clinic, including before/after content with proper patient consent.
* Write on-brand captions that reflect Be Clinical's voice and comply with advertising and medical/aesthetic guidelines.
* Monitor and respond to comments, DMs, tags, and reviews — routing qualified leads directly into the sales pipeline.
* Track engagement, follower growth, reach, and social-sourced leads; report monthly on performance.
* Stay current on platform trends, competitor activity, and aesthetic/clinical content best practices.

**Qualifications**

*Required*

* 1–3+ years in sales, inside sales, patient coordination, or lead conversion with measurable results.
* Experience managing social media for a business or brand, including content creation and community management.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; warm, professional, and confident phone presence.
* Strong organizational skills and comfort managing a high volume of leads and touchpoints.
* Comfort with CRM systems and social scheduling tools (e.g., Later, Meta Business Suite).
* Basic content creation skills using Canva, CapCut, or similar.
* Discretion and professionalism when handling sensitive patient information (HIPAA-aware).

*Preferred*

* Experience in medical aesthetics, med spa, dermatology, wellness, or a related clinical/consumer health environment.
* Familiarity with patient management platforms, booking software, and email marketing tools.
* Light photography or video editing skills.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Lead response time
* Lead-to-consultation and consultation-to-treatment conversion rates
* Consultation show rate
* Monthly revenue converted
* CRM data accuracy and pipeline hygiene
* Social engagement, follower growth, and social-sourced leads

**Schedule, Compensation & Benefits**

* Tuesday-Friday 9:30am-6:00pm & Saturday 9:00am-3:00pm
* Competitive base plus performance-based commission/bonus tied to conversion metrics.
* Paid time off and standard benefits.
* Ongoing training and professional development.
* Growth opportunities as Be Clinical expands.\

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $24.00 - $26.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* Lead generation: 2 years (Required)
* Social media marketing: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Account Manager, Lyft Ads
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft Ads' vision is to build the largest transportation media network. We leverage media to elevate the transportation experience for our riders while building an exciting and sustainable advertising business. Our advertising opportunities include Lyft in-app homepage and in-ride products, off-platform audience extension retargeting, and IRL experiential executions. Our work is fun, challenging, and rewarding, and we're looking for someone who's excited to help grow our partnerships.

As an Account Manager, you'll report to the West Coast Account Management Lead and serve as a strategic partner to Account Executives on multiple books of advertiser and agency accounts. You'll own campaigns from pitch through wrap, act as the main day-to-day contact for clients post-sale, and work across Sales, Ad Ops, Product, Data, and other teams to deliver strong results. You'll also help improve the processes and tools our sales team relies on. We're looking for someone who loves solving interesting problems, works well with autonomy, and cares deeply about client success and growth.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Pre-sales planning: Partner with Account Executives on RFP responses and media plans, including inventory forecasting, takeover/events calendar checks, and recommending the right mix of products to meet client goals.
* Data hygiene: Keep pitched and booked inventory and campaign data accurate across internal systems and CRMs, and flag gaps or risks early.
* Post-sales execution: Own all post-sale work for your book of business, including contract execution, creative services, and campaign reporting.
* Cross-functional liaison: Act as the point of contact between clients and Ad Operations, Legal, Product, Engineering, and other teams, resolving issues independently and escalating when needed.
* Ad campaign trafficking and optimization: Partner with Ad Operations to manage direct campaigns via internal planning tools and ad server, including ticketing, setup, scheduling, pacing, and full delivery against Insertion Order terms. Proactively recommend optimizations to improve performance.
* Measurement and reporting: Build campaign and wrap reports, turn results into clear insights and next-step recommendations, and lead measurement studies where applicable.
* Billing: Coordinate with Lyft Billing at the end of each billing cycle on campaign totals and make sure invoices are accurate and delivered on time.
* Client relationships: Own day-to-day client and agency relationships post-sale. Lead check-ins and wrap meetings, and partner with the AE to identify renewal and upsell opportunities.

**Experience:**
---------------

* BA/BS degree and 3-5 years of experience in digital advertising account management, media planning, or campaign management.
* Experience managing client and agency relationships directly and owning a book of business.
* Proficient in Google Suite products, particularly Google Sheets and Drive.
* Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills.
* Outstanding attention to detail.
* Comfortable managing multiple campaigns across the full ad lifecycle at once, with minimal oversight.
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking, with the ability to turn data into clear recommendations for sales teams and clients.
* Self-motivated and proactive in finding new solutions before being asked.

* Family building benefits

Account Management at Uber means navigating ambiguity, earning trust fast, and solving problems that don’t come with a script. jobs.description:
**GENERAL SUMMARY**

The Bay Club Operations Associate is an exciting opportunity to gain experience across multiple areas of Club operations while creating memorable experiences for members and guests every day. It's more than a support role; Associates contribute to the overall success of the Club by supporting hospitality, fitness, facility operations, and member services. This role provides a unique opportunity to explore different departments, build valuable skills, and discover potential career paths within the organization. This role is ideal for individuals who enjoy variety, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and are excited to develop new skills while building a foundation for future advancement. Bay Club Associates are expected to deliver outstanding service, uphold safety and cleanliness standards, support daily Club operations, and bring a positive, energetic, and professional attitude to every interaction.

  

**Our Culture**

Our unique culture is at the heart of all we do and is guided by our values and behaviors. It's what we expect of ourselves and each other every day. We call it our "Code of Culture".

Our Code of Culture includes Our Mantra, Our Actions We Live By, and Pete's Promise:

**Our Mantra:**

Respect The Past

Accept Responsibility

Pay it Forward

**Our Actions We Live By:**

**Actions We Live By**. It's who we are when we step into our full power.

**Keep It Real. Always.** We need open and honest discussions. We need courage to speak up and to call things out that aren't good enough. And we navigate tough conversations with empathy and grace.

**Think Ahead. Be An Owner**. Always be proactive, not reactive; be on the front foot. If we want to be an owner of this business, we must act like it!

**Stay Humble. Hustle Harder.** Show up and do the hard work. Be a gritty, roll-up-your-sleeves kind of crew. Know it's never about one person-we are a part of a powerful team.

**One Team. One Voice.** Be ONE united team. When we move in the same direction, there are no limits to what we can accomplish.

**Be Curious. Ask Why**. Stay member curious. We seek to understand, and we never settle. We ask questions to truly understand the core of a matter.

**Pete's Promise:**

Service Forward

Ruthlessly Consistent

Do the Right Thing

**Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.**

### **PRIMARY JOB FUNCTIONS**

### **Club Cleanliness & Housekeeping**

* Maintain cleanliness and appearance standards throughout assigned Club areas, including fitness spaces, locker rooms, lobby, reception desks, pool areas, restrooms, and common areas.

### **Customer Service & Member Experience**

* Greet members and guests upon arrival and throughout the Club.

* Book appointments, programs, services, and class reservations.
* Provide information regarding Club amenities, programming, events, and services.
* Deliver exceptional service experiences to members, guests, and fellow Associates.
* Build positive relationships with members and guests through proactive engagement and responsiveness.
* Represent the Club professionally through image, communication, follow-through, and responsiveness.
* Assist in generating membership and program leads by identifying prospective member interest.

### **Reception & Operational Support**

* Answer and transfer incoming phone calls.
* Assist with property tours and membership sales as needed.
* Operate point-of-sale systems and cash registers.
* Process payments and member account charges.
* Complete opening and closing duties for assigned operational areas.
* Support Club events, programs, and special activities.
* Assist in operational coverage across departments as business needs require.

### **Fitness Operations**

* Provide general supervision of fitness and recovery areas.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description:
Collections today works like an emergency room. The doctors carry too many patients, everyone arrives at their worst moment, and nobody has their chart. We're making it primary care. January personalizes interactions and optimizes decisions across every stage of consumer credit. We started in the hardest, most broken stage, because if it works there it works anywhere.

Most consumers want to pay what they owe. They want a way out, not a break. We've serviced over $20 billion in debt across more than 20 million consumers. We see more people with charged-off loans each year than all but the top five US banks. Those consumers rate us about 50% higher than the banks that lent them the money. Creditors net over 30% more because we collect more and charge less.

Most AI strips the human out of the work. We use it to make someone's hardest financial moment more human. The more human we make it, the more people recover. Now we're moving upstream, catching people before they default and building across every stage of the consumer credit lifecycle. The consumer in collections today is the consumer who gets approved tomorrow.

**About the Role**
==================

January is growing, and every hire we make depends on a recruiting process that moves quickly and treats candidates like the exceptional talent they are. As our sole Recruiting Coordinator, you’ll be be the face of January throughout the candidate journey. You own their experience end to end: every confirmation, reschedule, onsite, and follow-up is a chance to make the best possible impression on a candidate. Behind the scenes, you’ll be the operational backbone of our recruiting function, covering communications, scheduling, onsite logistics, and Ashby hygiene across every role.

Done well, recruiting feels seamless for candidates and for the team. Candidates always know what’s next, and no one on our side has to ask whether we’ve reached out to a candidate, whether an interview needs to be rescheduled, or when an onsite is happening, because you’ve already handled it and told the right people. Your work decides whether a great candidate with another offer on the table hears from us in minutes or in days, and whether they leave every interaction excited about working at January.

This role is for a proactive, detail-oriented, and strategic operator who looks around corners to see bottlenecks before they form and sweats the details that make candidates feel valued. You’ll build real relationships with candidates, recruiters, hiring managers, and interviewers. And you’ll set coordination up to run without you in the room, using AI to take over the repetitive work so you can spend more time on the human moments.

**You Will**
============

* **Delight every candidate at every step.** Be a warm, responsive, and polished point of contact from first outreach through offer. Set clear expectations on timing and next steps, prepare candidates for each interview, and make sure no one is left wondering where they stand.
* **Run an interview calendar without surprises.** Own scheduling, confirmations, and reschedules in Ashby across time zones, including same-day swaps when conflicts hit. Hold interviewer load to weekly caps, flag over- and underutilized interviewers, and build expedited loops (full process and debrief) around a candidate’s competing offer deadline.
* **Own onsites and internal setup for each pipeline.** Plan onsite logistics so every visit feels welcoming and well organized. Set up each role at kickoff, send interviewer briefs before every invite, and keep interviewers trained and calibrated on the experience we want candidates to have. Schedule debriefs with enough notice for the panel to prep.
* **Keep Ashby and candidate logistics correct.** Own role setup from approval to first interview, candidate communications, and the handoff to HR at offer. Keep interviewers, stages, and statuses current so the team works from one source of truth, and share the weekly scheduling read (time to booking, reschedule rate, interviewer load) with recruiters. Pair it with candidate feedback so we know how the experience feels from the other side.
* **Make coordination survive anyone’s absence.** Own the coordination SOP, train backups and recruiters, and turn recurring problems into Ashby automations and AI-assisted workflows. Bring recurring problems to recruiters with a proposed fix.

**What We Need**
================

* You treat every candidate interaction as a reflection of January. You write warm, clear, personal messages, anticipate questions before candidates ask them, and advocate for the candidate experience in every decision, even when it’s the harder path internally.
* You catch errors before they reach a candidate: the wrong time zone, another role’s guide, a double-booked interviewer. You build checks into the process so accuracy doesn’t depend on having a good day.
* You treat a time-sensitive change as the first task of the day. You resolve same-day swaps and competing-offer deadlines in minutes, and respond to the real deadline, not the loudest request. You acknowledge every request quickly, with a clear view on when it will be resolved.
* You keep a dozen requests moving and order the queue by deadline, business impact, and candidate risk. When constraints collide, you make the call if it’s reversible, and escalate with a recommendation if it isn’t.
* You don’t wait for direction. You close every loop without being chased, flag early when something is stuck, and chase interviewers and hiring managers for feedback, availability, and prep. You identify potential blockers before they become real problems.
* You communicate in a way that can’t be misread, and you build real relationships with candidates and internal stakeholders. You hold the line with senior leaders when needed to protect the candidate’s experience and timeline.
* You turn a fix you make twice into a rule, template, or automation, documented so anyone else can run

**About Kirkland & Ellis**

At Kirkland & Ellis, we don’t just meet the standard for legal excellence — we set it. Our culture is built on teamwork, ingenuity and an unwavering commitment to continuous growth. We tackle the most sophisticated legal challenges with bold ideas and innovative solutions, powered by the exceptional experience and ambition of our 7,000+ people, including 4,000+ attorneys, across 24 offices worldwide. Our dedicated professionals share our lawyers’ commitment to excellence and show up each day to do meaningful work that helps drive global business, investment and innovation forward.

**What You’ll Do**

Are you a detail-oriented purchasing professional who enjoys keeping complex processes moving, solving issues, and partnering with teams and suppliers to get things done?

As a Purchasing Coordinator, you’ll support the firm’s end-to-end purchasing and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) function, helping ensure purchasing transactions are accurate, timely, and compliant with firm policies. From reviewing requisitions and managing purchase orders to resolving invoice issues and maintaining supplier records, you’ll serve as a key resource for internal stakeholders and external suppliers. You’ll also partner closely with Procurement Sourcing and Finance teams to maintain accurate purchasing data, address process issues, and identify opportunities to improve the P2P experience.  
  

* Purchasing & Purchase Order Administration: Review and approve purchase requisitions, purchase order (PO) changes, and PO invoices, ensuring requests align with supporting supplier documentation, payment terms, fee schedules, timelines, descriptions, amounts, and required approvals.
* P2P Monitoring & Compliance: Monitor automated reports and end-to-end P2P workflows to identify delays, errors, trends, or noncompliance, researching issues, enforcing purchasing policies, and coordinating escalations and resolution as needed.
* Supplier & Order Management: Confirm suppliers are accurately established and active within the appropriate systems, ensure approved POs and PO change requests are successfully transmitted, and work directly with suppliers to fulfill orders and resolve purchasing or invoicing issues.
* Invoice & Payment Support: Collaborate with Finance teams and suppliers to resolve invoice matching discrepancies and help ensure supplier invoices are processed accurately and efficiently for payment.
* Supplier Onboarding & Records: Partner with internal business users, suppliers, Purchasing team members, and the Sourcing team to support new supplier onboarding and maintain accurate, up-to-date supplier and contract information within the P2P system.
* Customer Service & Coordination: Manage the shared Purchasing inbox, including daily triage, responses, internal coordination, and supplier communications, while providing responsive support to stakeholders throughout the purchasing process.
* Card-Based Purchasing: Process Purchasing Card (P-Card) and/or Virtual Card (V-Card) order requests in partnership with Procurement’s Vendor Management team.
* Team & Process Support: Provide coverage for Purchasing Coordinators in other offices, identify and recommend opportunities to improve P2P processes, and support additional Purchasing team needs as assigned.

**What You’ll Bring**

* A bachelor’s degree in accounting or business, or equivalent experience along with a Purchasing Certification is required; 3+ years of purchasing or procurement experience required.
* Purchasing Experience: Three or more years of purchasing or procurement experience, with the ability to effectively support purchasing processes, stakeholders, and suppliers.
* Relationship & Customer Service Skills: Demonstrated ability to build effective relationships with internal stakeholders and suppliers, supported by strong interpersonal skills, sound judgment, and a service-oriented approach.
* Organization & Attention to Detail: Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage deadlines, prioritize competing responsibilities, and maintain accuracy in a dynamic environment, with availability to work overtime periodically as business needs require.
* Professional Judgment & Confidentiality: Ability to communicate professionally with firm staff and suppliers while appropriately safeguarding confidential client and firm information.
* Technology Skills: Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, web browsers, and P2P software solutions, along with a willingness to learn and grow as processes and technologies evolve.

If you’re excited to keep purchasing operations running smoothly, build strong partnerships, and make an impact across the Procure-to-Pay process, we’d love to hear from you for this Purchasing Coordinator opportunity!

**Compensation**

The base salary range below represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position in each of the below locations. This range may differ based on your geographic location and cost of living considerations. At Kirkland & Ellis, we consider compensation more than just a base salary. We offer an exceptional range of flexible benefits including comprehensive healthcare, paid time off, and retirement. We also offer personal support and tailored learning and development opportunities all designed to help you realize your full potential both in life and at work.

**Location and Working Pattern:** New York Metro Preferred (Manhattan ideal), Hybrid/Flexible, Remote employment for the ideal candidate

(Final compensation will be commensurate with experience and location)

**Who We Are**

QA is a global leader in technology and digital skills development, helping organizations build critical capabilities across AI, cloud, cybersecurity, data, software development, DevOps, digital transformation, leadership, and professional skills through instructor-led, virtual instructor-led, and digital learning solutions.

**Role Overview**

The Customer Success Manager serves as the primary customer success partner for a portfolio of mid-market and scaled customers. The role is responsible for driving customer adoption, retention, value realization, and overall customer health throughout the customer lifecycle. Working in partnership with Account Managers, the Customer Success Manager develops and executes customer success strategies that help customers achieve measurable business outcomes while identifying growth opportunities that can be advanced through Customer Success Qualified Leads (CSQLs). Success in this role requires a combination of customer success expertise, stakeholder management, program coordination, and scalable customer engagement capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer Lifecycle Management**

* Own customer onboarding, adoption, engagement, and value realization activities across an assigned portfolio.
* Develop and maintain customer success plans aligned to customer goals and business outcomes.
* Proactively identify customer risks and drive mitigation plans to improve retention and customer outcomes.
* Serve as the primary advocate for customer needs and objectives throughout the customer lifecycle.

**Customer Success & Retention**

* Drive ongoing customer adoption and utilization across QA learning solutions.
* Maintain a clear understanding of customer objectives, use cases, stakeholders, and success measures.
* Support renewal planning activities in partnership with assigned Account Managers.

**Joint Account Strategy & Planning**

* Partner closely with Account Managers to develop and execute account success strategies.
* Contribute customer insights, stakeholder intelligence, adoption trends, and risk assessments to account planning activities.
* Identify Customer Success Qualified Leads (CSQLs) and collaborate with Account Managers to advance growth opportunities.
* Align customer success activities to broader account objectives and customer business priorities.

**Program Coordination & Execution**

* Coordinate instructor-led training engagements and blended learning programs.
* Manage customer communications, milestones, action plans, and stakeholder alignment activities.
* Monitor program progress, identify delivery risks, and coordinate with internal teams to ensure successful execution and customer outcomes.

**Executive Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders across technology, learning and development, and business functions.
* Facilitate business reviews and outcome-focused customer discussions.
* Present recommendations, adoption insights, and success strategies to customer stakeholders.
* Navigate complex customer environments with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

**Scaled Customer Success & Adoption**

* Deliver one-to-many and one-to-few customer engagement activities, including webinars, office hours, enablement sessions, and adoption-focused campaigns.
* Use customer health indicators, engagement trends, lifecycle milestones, and success metrics to prioritize and execute digital customer success activities at scale.
* Gather customer feedback, identify recurring challenges, and implement scalable approaches that improve customer experience, adoption, and outcomes.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Gross Revenue Retention (GRR)
* Customer Success Qualified Leads (CSQLs)
* Customer Adoption and Engagement
* Verified Customer Outcomes
* Success Plan Completion
* Customer Advocacy, Reference Participation, and Business Review Completion

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

**Experience**

* 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Learning Services, Professional Services, or customer-facing consulting roles.
* Experience supporting instructor-led training, workforce development, learning services, or blended learning programs.
* Experience managing a portfolio of customer relationships and competing priorities.
* Experience delivering presentations, webinars, enablement sessions, and business reviews while coordinating across customer stakeholders and internal teams.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Data analysis, customer storytelling, and business outcome communication.
* Customer success planning and value realization.
* Strong stakeholder management, relationship-building, communication, and presentation skills.
* Program and project coordination.
* Experience leveraging Salesforce and customer success technologies.
* Strong organizational, time-management, and portfolio management skills.
