Join QA and help shape the future of work for some of the world's most recognized organizations. Partner with leaders across technology, learning, and business functions to help customers close capability gaps, accelerate workforce transformation, and achieve measurable business outcomes.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About Fundwell**
------------------

Fundwell helps small and medium-sized businesses access capital with greater clarity, speed, and confidence. Our financial technology platform brings financing options and experienced specialists together, helping business owners compare offers, understand their choices, and move from application to funding through a streamlined process.  
  
We combine technology with personal guidance because financing is more than a transaction it can help a business hire its next employee, purchase equipment, or pursue its next stage of growth. Our team makes those decisions easier to navigate, building relationships grounded in transparency and trust.

**Your Role at Fundwell**
-------------------------

Build your sales career where great sales careers start: on the phone.  
  
As an Opener, you are the first voice a business owner hears from Fundwell. You’ll make high-volume cold calls, supported by email and text, to reach business owners, find out what they need, and bring in the application that starts their path to funding. Then you’ll hand the deal to one of our closers with everything they need to take it from there.  
  
This role is built for people who want to get good at sales, fast. You’ll learn a proven call framework, get daily coaching and call reviews, and watch your confidence grow with every dial. You don’t need years of experience. You need drive, resilience, and a real willingness to pick up the phone.  
  
**How You’ll Make an Impact**

**Drive outreach**

* Make high-volume outbound calls each day and meet your activity goals.
* Reach business owners and turn conversations into applications.
* Stay resilient and keep your energy up through every call.

**Lead strong conversations**

* Follow a proven sales approach on every call.
* Understand each business owner’s needs and goals.
* Handle objections with confidence and move every conversation forward.
* Set clear, accurate expectations.

**Follow through**

* Follow up consistently across channels.
* Deliver complete applications and a smooth handoff to the next stage.
* Keep clear, organized records.

**Grow with the team**

* Use coaching and feedback to keep improving.
* Act with honesty and integrity with every customer.
* Bring energy that helps make the team a great place to work.

**What Success Looks Like**

* **Activity:** You stay consistent and hit your daily activity goals.
* **Conversations:** You run quality conversations that uncover what each customer needs.
* **Applications:** You make it easy for clients to get through the application process.
* **Organization:** You keep clear records so anyone on the team can pick up where you left off.
* **Growth:** You take coaching and feedback seriously and keep getting better.

**What You’ll Bring**

* **Confidence on the phone:** You’re comfortable talking to new people, or you really want to get there.
* **Resilience:** You hear “no,” learn from it, and keep going with the same energy.
* **Curiosity:** You listen well and ask questions to understand each customer.
* **Drive:** You’re competitive, self-motivated, and focused on results and growth.
* **Coachability:** You’re humble and eager to learn, and you act on feedback quickly.
* **Organization:** You follow through and pick up new tools quickly.
* **Nice to have:** Sales, customer-facing, hospitality, or competitive athletics experience. No financial services background needed.

**Why Fundwell?**

* **Compensation:** On-target earnings of $90K–$250K, with commission and bonus.
* Learn sales the right way, with structured training, a proven call framework, and daily coaching.
* Work alongside experienced closers and learn how deals get from first call to funding.
* Grow your career with a growing fintech company, with opportunities for advancement.
* Paid time off and a 401(k) plan, with benefits eligibility after 90 days.
* An energetic, collaborative team in our downtown New York office.

**Our Commitment to You**

Fundwell is an equal employment opportunity employer. We adhere to a policy of making employment decisions without regard to age, race, color, creed, religion, political affiliation, gender, sexual orientation, sexual identification, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, marital status, domestic or civil union partnership status, disability or handicap, veteran or military status (e.g. National Guard or Reserves).

Compensation Range: $90K - $250K

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to track assigned tasks and meet deadlines without frequent reminders.

jobs.title: Customer Success Consultant (SME) in Analytical Products
jobs.description:
**Customer Success Consultant (SME) – Analytical Products**

  

**About the team**

The Subject Matter Expert (SME) team is part of Elsevier Customer Success and brings deep product and domain expertise across Elsevier solutions. We work closely with Customer Success Managers (CSMs), Sales, SEMs, Product, Support, and Customer Education to support complex customer needs, strengthen adoption and value realization, and support key customer accounts.

The team also brings customer and market insights back into the business to help improve our products, services, and customer experience.

  
  

**Purpose of the job**

The Customer Success Consultant (SME) – Software Solutions provides advanced product and domain expertise, consultative support, and institution-level advisory services for Elsevier customers throughout the post-sales customer journey.

The role partners closely with CSMs, Sales, and other internal teams to help customers address complex needs, adopt and embed Elsevier solutions into their institutional workflows, and achieve meaningful business and research outcomes.

The SME is expected to engage proactively where specialist expertise can improve customer value, address adoption gaps, support strategic use cases, or help mitigate customer risk. The role complements the responsibilities of CSMs and SEMs, with clear alignment on ownership and engagement to avoid duplication or gaps in coverage.

The role maintains a deep product focus while applying relevant domain expertise, including knowledge of research evaluation, bibliometrics, scientometrics, data analysis, and the scholarly research and publishing ecosystem.

  
  

**Responsibilities**

  

* Partner with CSMs, Sales, SEMs, and regional leaders to identify accounts needing specialist intervention, and engage proactively with priority accounts rather than relying solely on reactive requests.
* Provide institution-level advisory support – helping customers clarify priorities, interpret data and indicators, and embed Elsevier solutions into institutional processes, workflows, and evaluation systems.
* Coordinate with CSMs and Customer Education to drive adoption and advanced use of Software Products (e.g., Pure), and support customers through complex use cases, change management, and process improvement.
* Demonstrate deep knowledge of Elsevier’s capabilities relative to customer priorities and competitors, taking ownership of strategic use cases from defining the desired outcome through follow-up on impact.

* Maintain visibility of SME activity, account priorities, and outcomes through agreed systems (including Gainsight), while maintaining clear role boundaries with CSMs, SEMs, Sales, and Support so SME expertise complements existing coverage.
* Maintain strong knowledge of Elsevier AI solutions, the broader generative AI landscape, and domain expertise in bibliometrics, research evaluation, and the scholarly publishing ecosystem, applying it to customer and business needs.
* Partner across Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Customer Education to feed customer and market insights back into the business, and to develop and improve customer-facing learning materials and internal knowledge sharing.
* Help identify recurring customer needs, market trends, and adoption barriers to inform enablement, product development, and service delivery.
  

  

**Requirements**

  

* Have a university bachelor’s degree; master’s, doctorate, or equivalent relevant experience valued.
* Display exceptional technical and business knowledge of Elsevier Software Products; knowledge of Engineering Products or other relevant Elsevier solutions a plus.
* Have relevant background in software development, scholarly publishing, information science, data analysis, computer science, or a related field.
* Display good understanding of customer needs, workflows, and the scholarly research and publishing ecosystem.
* Have excellent consultative, customer success, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Leverage a strategic and critical-thinking skills with a solution-oriented mindset.
* Have demonstrated ability to translate customer priorities into practical advisory plans, use cases, and measurable outcomes.
* Able to work proactively and with a high degree of autonomy, while collaborating effectively across teams.
* Have excellent analytical, data storytelling, presentation, facilitation, and communication skills.
* Experience with Elsevier products or similar analytical and AI solutions.
* Experience working in an international matrix organization.
* Have excellent English skills; additional languages are valued.
* Able to work effectively with CSMs, Sales, SEMs, Product, Support, Customer Education, and regional leadership while maintaining clear ownership boundaries.
  

  

**Work in a way that works for you**

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager, Paid Social
jobs.description:
**The Team + The Role**
-----------------------

Pendo's Growth Marketing team builds campaigns that capture high-intent demand and drive pipeline. The team connects with prospective buyers throughout their journey, from building awareness to generating demo requests. We partner across marketing to turn campaign insights into measurable business results.

Reporting to the Director of Growth Marketing, you'll own Pendo's paid social program across Meta, LinkedIn, and Reddit. You'll lead channel strategy, hands-on campaign execution, optimization, and budget management across the full buyer journey. You'll work closely with Product Marketing, Creative, Web, Marketing Operations, and other paid media channel owners to launch coordinated campaigns, improve performance, and grow pipeline contribution.

This is a role based in-office in Raleigh or New York, or Remote in the United States.

**What this looks like day-to-day**
-----------------------------------

* **Full-funnel paid social strategy:** Build and execute a paid social strategy that spans awareness through demo requests, with clear objectives for each stage of the buyer journey. Measure the program's contribution to pipeline and adjust channel strategy based on performance.
* **Hands-on campaign management:** Build, launch, and manage campaigns directly in Meta, LinkedIn, and Reddit. Run targeted, small-scale tests on emerging or relevant platforms, including X, when there's a clear audience fit.
* **Testing and optimization:** Continuously refine campaign structure and test audiences, creative, messaging, and placements to improve results. Use AI tools to develop ad copy variants, explore audience hypotheses, and streamline reporting. Share findings and recommendations for program expansion with the Director of Growth Marketing.
* **Performance analysis:** Regularly analyze channel and campaign performance to identify opportunities to improve efficiency and demand generation. Use performance data to determine which campaigns to scale, adjust, or optimize.
* **Budget management:** Own the paid social budget, forecast spend, and manage pacing against monthly and quarterly plans. Identify budget or performance risks early and recommend adjustments to keep investment aligned with program objectives.
* **Cross-channel collaboration:** Partner with paid search and other media channel owners to align messaging and share campaign insights. Work with Creative, Product Marketing, Web, and Marketing Operations to bring coordinated campaigns to market. Demonstrate The Team is Pendo by sharing results openly and incorporating Sales feedback into campaign improvements.

**Who You Are**
---------------

Beyond the qualifications, we hire through a specific lens. These aren't buzzwords; they're the things we'll actually look for in how you talk about your work.

You're a builder, not a maintainer.

You're most energized when there isn't a clear path yet, and you get to define it. You don't wait for direction; you identify gaps, shape solutions, and drive them forward. At Pendo, great Digital Marketing Managers don't just follow instructions; they operate as strategic advisors, influencing decisions, guiding stakeholders, and elevating how we work.

You're AI-curious - genuinely.

You're not using AI tools occasionally. You're rewiring how you work around them. Vestwell offers a range of products, including workplace-delivered retirement plans, employer-offered student loan repayment benefits, and various savings accounts for education, emergencies, and individuals with disabilities.

Vestwell's platform serves a diverse clientele, including financial advisers, employers, third-party administrators, financial institutions, payroll providers, government agencies, and individual savers. To learn more, visit vestwell.com

The expected OTE for this position is approximately $72K ($60K base + up to $12K variable). Please note that salary bands are based on NY and other similar metro areas and may differ based on where the role is ultimately hired.

**Full-Time Employee Benefits**

The Met presents over 5,000 years of art from around the world for everyone to experience and enjoy. The Museum lives in two iconic sites in New York City—The Met Fifth Avenue and The Met Cloisters. Millions of people also take part in The Met experience online.

Since its founding in 1870, The Met has always aspired to be more than a treasury of rare and beautiful objects. We are committed to fostering a collaborative and respectful work environment with a staff as diverse as the audiences we engage. Our staff members are art lovers who are passionate about working toward a common goal: creating the most dynamic and inspiring art museum in the world.

At The Met, every staff member – from security officers to researchers to scientists and beyond – lives by our core values of respect, inclusivity, collaboration, excellence, and integrity.

**Respect:** Engage one another with collegiality, empathy, and kindness, always.

**Inclusivity:** Ensure that all are and feel welcome and valued.

**Collaboration:** Reach across boundaries to exchange ideas and work together toward our shared mission.

Position Summary:

The Executive Assistant to the President is responsible for all day-to-day administrative needs of the President of the Council. Reporting to the Chief of Staff to the President, the Executive Assistant works as a close partner to the Chief of Staff in managing the President’s time, priorities, and commitments. This position provides executive-level administrative support, including oversight of complex scheduling of meetings and events, extensive domestic and international travel arrangements, tracking of expenses, monitoring incoming communications from multiple channels, and coordinating with all units of the Council to track the President’s initiatives and route inquiries. This full-time position is based on-site at CFR’s New York City or Washington, DC office five days per week.

Essential Functions/Responsibilities:

* Provide high-level administrative support to the President, including extensive scheduling of appointments, speaking engagements, internal and external board meetings, and media appearances.
* Manage the President’s calendar by responding to inquiries, requests, and invitations.
* Closely track the President’s commitments and responsibilities, liaise with the President’s senior leadership team, and follow up with internal and external partners as needed for relevant information.
* Monitor incoming communications to the President’s individual and generic email inboxes, flagging urgent or critical items as needed.
* Manage and coordinate all aspects of the President’s domestic and international travel, including itinerary development, transportation, accommodations, travel documentation, and other logistical arrangements.
* Assist with the planning and coordination of small-scale events and engagements hosted by the President, including guest arrangements, invitations, event logistics, and preparation of relevant materials.
* Oversee the preparation, tracking, and processing of the President’s expense reports and reimbursements.
* Maintain and manage the President’s electronic and physical records, including confidential correspondence, administrative documents, and other materials.
* Handle ad hoc projects as assigned by the Chief of Staff to the President, which may include coordinating Executive Office initiatives or assisting with high-priority tasks.
* Perform any other duties or tasks as assigned or required.

Minimum Qualifications:

**Education and** **Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree required. Master’s degree preferred.
* At least five years of related administrative experience working for senior executives.

**Related Skills & Other Requirements**

* Expert Microsoft Office Suite skills, including Outlook, Word, Excel, Teams, and other virtual meeting platforms. Experience working with databases.
* Outstanding organizational, attention to detail, and time management skills, including the ability to prioritize multiple tasks.
* Proven experience working with high-level external and internal stakeholders.
* Exceptional judgment and discretion, especially in handling confidential information and solving problems in the moment.
* Excellent communication, business writing, and proofreading skills.
* Proven ability to work independently as well as on a team, and to respond to shifting priorities.

Required Application Materials:

Please submit a résumé and cover letter stating your interest in the position.

Compensation and Benefits:

* The full-time annual compensation range for this position is $90,000 – $115,000, depending on experience.
* In addition to competitive salaries, CFR provides employees with an outstanding benefits package.

About CFR:

The Council on Foreign Relations (CFR) is committed to fostering a foreign policy community in the United States that is more representative of American society, recognizing that diverse backgrounds and perspectives contribute to broader, more informed participation in the foreign policy debate and lead to an enhanced understanding of the world and the United States’ role therein. To that end, CFR is dedicated to continuing to advance diversity, equity, and inclusion throughout its work and workplace by building a more diverse membership and staff, producing and dispensing thoughtful analysis on a broad range of foreign policy issues, and developing relevant, wide-reaching programming that also serves to expand the foreign policy talent pipeline to underrepresented populations.

jobs.description:
**About the Agency:**

The Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) oversees housing standards across all 3.7 million homes in New York City.

As the nation’s largest municipal housing agency, HPD is responsible for building and preserving affordable housing, protecting tenants from harassment and displacement, and holding landlords accountable across the five boroughs. Under Commissioner Dina Levy and the Mamdani Administration, HPD is pursuing an ambitious housing agenda focused on the needs of New York’s tenants. With a broad set of tools including standards enforcement, tenant resources, and the creation of new affordable housing, HPD is committed to making New York City a more affordable place for renters and homeowners alike.

**Your Team:**   
The Office of Development (OOD) leads the agency’s effort to create and preserve housing in collaboration with other HPD offices as well as other city, state and federal agencies.

The Office of Development is composed of eight divisions that administer a range of programs:

* New Construction Finance
* Special Needs Housing
* Building and Land Development Services (BLDS)
* Homeownership Opportunities and Preservation
* Preservation Finance
* Portfolio Management and Conversions
* Housing Incentives
* Compliance and Enforcement

The Division of Preservation Finance administers multiple financing programs to improve financial and physical conditions and preserve or create affordability within privately-owned multi-family and single-family buildings. The division oversees programs utilizing low-cost loans and property tax benefits among other public incentives.

**Your Impact:**  
The Division of Preservation Finance seeks an Assistant Project Manager for Multifamily Cooperative Preservation Team. The unit develops plans, strategies, and tools for effective affordable housing preservation initiatives, as well as analyzes, negotiates, and executes on financial transactions to preserve the physical and operational integrity of existing affordable housing developments under the Multifamily Housing Rehabilitation Program (HRP). The unit provides rehabilitation loans to multifamily affordable housing developments that cannot leverage private financing and only require financing for the replacement of major building systems to improve living conditions and preserve safe affordable housing for low- and moderate-income households in New York City.

**Your Role:**  
Under the supervision of the Director and Deputy Directors, in your role as Assistant Project Manager, you will be responsible for managing 2-3 City Capital projects per year through loan closing, including underwriting and completing due diligence. In addition, you will be responsible for assisting program staff in intaking and assigning new capital projects, conducting outreach, and completing due diligence for upcoming loan closings.

**Your Responsibilities:**

As Assistant Project Manager, you will perform duties including, but not limited to the following:

· Manage 2-3 capitally funded projects per year through loan closing, including underwriting and completing due diligence requirements

· Act as first point of contact to building owners seeking to learn more about the Multifamily Housing Rehabilitation Program, including monitoring project application submissions, responding to inquiries to the program’s email account and hotline and scheduling meetings with potential borrowers.

· Assist with the intake of projects applying to the Multifamily Housing Rehabilitation Program, including reviewing applications and collecting missing application materials, performing preliminary financial analysis and discussing the terms of HPD’s loan programs with the prospective borrower.

· Track and coordinate the receipt of application information by maintaining and updating sophisticated intake tracker with borrower information.

· Assist with determining the appropriate loan program and Project Manager for the project.

· Coordinate intake and outreach efforts with teams across the agency, including staffing outreach events, and creating marketing and/or outreach materials.

· Produce detailed reports, presentations, and written correspondence regarding project inquiries and applications

· Attend meetings, develop agendas and maintain minutes for various projects and internal and external meetings.

· Assist Project Managers and Senior Project Managers complete due diligence on their projects.

· Assist with ad hoc tracking and special projects, as needed.

The ideal candidate will have experience in a collaborative environment, possess strong organization and communication skills, be detail-oriented, and be proficient in Microsoft Office Suite.

· Interest in community development, urban planning, affordable housing or real estate finance.

· Advanced computer skills including competency in full Microsoft Office suite, especially Excel.

· Capacity to simultaneously work on multiple tasks and set priorities for a challenging workload.

· Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Excellent writing and editing skills.

· 1-2 years of applicable experience working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment preferred.

**How to Apply:**

Please email resume and cover letter to: JobsPF@hpd.nyc.gov

**Salary range for this position is: approximately $70,000 annual salary (based on a 35 hour work week with a required unpaid lunch)**

**NOTE: Please note that this is a temp position that is anticipated to conclude approximately one (1) year from hire date or later. Please note that due to this being a Temporary Employment Position we are unable to sponsor candidates that require visa support.**

**Work Location:** **100 Gold Street, New York, NY**

Pay: $70,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

**Job Description**

**Social Media Coordinator & Evaluator**

**PCI Professional Services**

**Position Summary**

PCI Professional Services is seeking an experienced **Social Media Coordinator & Evaluator** to support digital communications initiatives within the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention's (CDC) Global Health Center (GHC), Office of the Associate Director for Communication (ADC).

The successful candidate will support the planning, coordination, execution, and evaluation of social media communications designed to advance CDC's global public health mission. This position requires a combination of strategic communications expertise, content development capabilities, stakeholder coordination, and data-driven performance analysis.

The Social Media Coordinator & Evaluator will collaborate with CDC communications professionals, subject matter experts, and technical teams to ensure social media content is accurate, accessible, timely, and aligned with organizational priorities and federal communications standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Social Media Strategy & Coordination**

* Coordinate the development and implementation of social media communications strategies supporting GHC priorities and initiatives.
* Develop and maintain editorial calendars to organize content, campaigns, publication schedules, and communication milestones.
* Collaborate with CDC stakeholders and subject matter experts to identify opportunities for audience engagement and public health messaging.
* Support integrated digital communications campaigns across multiple social media platforms.
* Monitor emerging social media trends and recommend approaches to strengthen audience engagement and content effectiveness.

**Content Development & Publishing**

* Develop, edit, and coordinate social media content that communicates complex public health information clearly and effectively.
* Prepare platform-specific messaging, graphics, and supporting materials consistent with CDC communications guidelines.
* Coordinate content reviews, approvals, and publication schedules with designated CDC stakeholders.
* Publish approved content using established social media management tools and workflows.
* Ensure content aligns with accessibility, plain-language, branding, and applicable federal communications requirements.

**Social Media Monitoring & Evaluation**

* Monitor social media activity, audience engagement, and campaign performance across designated platforms.
* Track key performance indicators, including reach, impressions, engagement rates, audience growth, and campaign effectiveness.
* Develop recurring performance reports, dashboards, and analytical summaries.
* Evaluate communication outcomes and identify opportunities to improve content strategy, audience targeting, and engagement.
* Translate social media analytics into actionable recommendations for CDC communications leadership.

**Stakeholder Coordination & Reporting**

* Collaborate with CDC communications teams, program offices, and subject matter experts to coordinate messaging and communications priorities.
* Support planning meetings, campaign development discussions, and communication reviews.
* Prepare status updates, performance summaries, and recommendations for government stakeholders.
* Maintain organized documentation of content calendars, campaign activities, performance metrics, and approval workflows.
* Support continuous improvement of social media processes, reporting practices, and communications effectiveness.

**Minimum Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, Journalism, Digital Media, or a related field.
* Equivalent combinations of education and relevant professional experience may be considered, subject to contract requirements.

**Experience**

* Minimum of **four years of relevant professional experience** in social media management, digital communications, public relations, or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated experience developing, coordinating, and publishing social media content across multiple platforms.
* Experience managing editorial calendars and coordinating communications campaigns.
* Experience analyzing social media metrics and preparing performance reports.

AWS is seeking a sales professional to manage a global customer relationship with one of our large global Automotive & Manufacturing customers. The Global Account Manager ("GAM") will partner with the customer to build strategic relationships, articulate a clear vision, and deliver business value. The successful GAM will develop and execute a broad strategy for earning customer trust and driving AWS solution and service adoption across the customer's Digital Technology, Operations, Line of Business (LoB), and Research & Development leadership. The GAM will also effectively leverage existing programs and mechanisms, innovate and scale new mechanisms, and develop formal case studies and other forms of references highlighting outcomes and solutions running on AWS.  
  
Why AWS?  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  
  
  
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Contributing to, and leading, within an AWS customer account team.  
  
Identifying and building trusted advisor relationships with key influencers and decision-makers, specifically CxOs at the customer, across Line of Business (LoB), Functional (R&D, Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain), and Digital & IT.  
  
Working closely with internal AWS teams (executives, solution architects, industry specialists, marketing, partners, enterprise support, service teams and professional services), as well as external SI and ISV partners, to support the best business solution(s) for customers.  
  
Defining a CXO relationship strategy within the customer, coordinating executive business reviews, and maintaining customer satisfaction levels.  
  
Displaying strong leadership presence and being able to command a room in a meeting. Should be seen as an authority in communicating via email, phone, and face to face, and comfortable writing executive briefing documents for, and communicating with, the most senior executives at the company.  
  
Operating with significant autonomy and discretion. A high degree of decision making is required in routine customer engagement, business judgment is critical.

Working with marketing and communications to develop formal references, PR and case studies highlighting impactful customer activity and workloads running on AWS.

Reports to the VP, Marketing, and serves as the VP’s right hand for field marketing, trusted to make decisions and keep the work moving; runs the field playbook end to end while Creative, CRM, and paid media own their lanes. This role manages systems, programs, and partners rather than direct reports. Works in person at Caliber stores and supports and coordinates activations for all Caliber locations, digitally and with local field support. Atlanta-based is preferred but not required; candidates based elsewhere travel monthly to Caliber markets in Atlanta, Dallas, or Florida.

This role exists to make marketing easier for the field, not to add to its workload. Success means district and site managers trust marketing, call marketing when something happens, and see results at their stores. The ideal candidate is a thinker as much as a doer: a people person who understands how marketing thinks, solves problems without waiting to be told how, and is ready to step up and own a program. They have experience running grassroots and local store marketing for a multi-unit retail or service brand; are hands-on, detail-oriented, and operator-minded; and expect to spend real time in the field working with field operations teams. They will also have a real hand in shaping how Caliber’s local store marketing system looks and works as it is built out.

Car wash may not be the first industry that comes to mind for a marketing career, and that is exactly the opportunity. Express car wash is a fast-growing, membership-driven business built on the same subscription model that powers streaming, software, and fitness brands. In this role, you’ll see firsthand how recurring revenue works: acquiring members, converting single-wash customers, and reducing churn, all measured store by store. Few roles at this stage of a marketing career combine hands-on local marketing with subscription-business experience, and both skill sets carry into any industry you choose next.

**Responsibilities**

The essential functions of this role include, but are not limited to, the following:

* Run Caliber’s local store marketing operating system and playbook.  
  Own the day-to-day system that site managers, district managers, and marketing use to plan and request local activity: work the marketing queue, keep store and district views current, and move plays from request to approval to launch. Manage the local store activation budget, measure what each play returns, and bring forward recommendations that shape how the system and playbook evolve.
* Drive local store marketing and grassroots activation that lifts store traffic.  
  Leverage a trade-area profile for each store (schools, employers, apartments, competitors, events) and turn it into activity: fundraisers with schools, teams, and nonprofits; affinity program activations; business, apartment, and other local partnerships; and community events. Run plays from the local store marketing playbook, built around the situational needs of individual car wash locations. Diagnose before prescribing, prioritize stores by need rather than spreading effort evenly, and measure through predetermined KPIs and store-level lift. In markets where stores are more spread out, such as Florida and Texas, coordinate activations with local field support, which may include contract partners.
* Own store-level marketing execution across signage, merchandising, and promotions.  
  Coordinate signage needs from a catalog; manage promo swaps, new-store and refresh rollouts, POS screen content, digital menus / reader boards, in-store merchandising, and store audits to ensure campaigns are live and accurate.
* Creatively produce organic social and community content as needed.
* Lead field marketing requests and cross-functional follow-through.  
  Serve as the marketing intake point for district and site managers. Turn field signals into action and close the loop on every request. Coordinate with Creative, CRM, paid media, Ops, IT, vendors, and webstore partners.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Degree not required, but a bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, public relations, business, or a related field is preferred. In its place, relevant experience, creativity, and curiosity carry equal weight.
* 1–3 years of field, local, retail, or multi-unit marketing experience is a plus. Coordinators and specialists ready to step up to their first manager role are encouraged to apply.

* Experience in a multi-unit, high-growth environment preferred. Car wash, QSR, or retail operations experience is a bonus.
* Energy and people skills: an outgoing people person who can talk to anyone, from site teammates to school principals and business owners, and brings the energy great field marketing runs on.
* Problem solver and self-starter: a thinker, not just a doer; sees what needs to happen, makes the call, and brings solutions forward rather than waiting for

**Project Development Coordinator**

**POSITION SUMMARY**  
The Project Development Coordinator supports the Authority’s affordable housing development and rehabilitation projects. Working with the Chief Property Officer and Senior Development Manager, this position coordinates financing applications, project documentation, due diligence, construction draws, and reporting requirements from planning through lease-up.

**Essential Responsibilities**  

* Coordinate project tasks, documents, schedules, and communications for affordable housing development and rehabilitation projects.
* Assist with applications for Low-Income Housing Tax Credits, tax-exempt bonds, Illinois Affordable Housing Tax Credits, Community Development Block Grants, HOME funds, and HUD’s Rental Assistance Demonstration (RAD) program.
* Prepare and update project pro formas, budgets, schedules, and reports for review by the Senior Development Manager and other project leaders.
* Gather and organize materials needed for financing, due diligence, and real estate closings. Help compare proposals from lenders and investors.
* Coordinate with lenders, investors, government agencies, and the Authority’s legal, architectural, financial, and accounting partners to keep project activities on track.
* Support RAD conversions and track related submissions, deadlines, and documentation.
* Attend owner, architect, and contractor meetings; document action items; and follow up on project schedules, budgets, and outstanding issues.
* Prepare monthly construction draw requests and track grant-funded activities against approved budgets, scopes of work, and timelines.
* Work with Leasing and Asset Management to coordinate marketing, lease-up, resident eligibility, and documentation needed for tax credit delivery.
* Track reporting and compliance deadlines associated with HUD, IHDA, investors, grants, and other funding sources.
* Participate in meetings about development projects and funding opportunities and serve on procurement evaluation committees, as assigned.
* Monitor grant-funded projects to ensure activities align with the approved budget, scope of work and timeline.
* Follow Authority policies and perform other related duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree in real estate, finance, economics, public administration, business administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience in affordable housing development or a related field. Experience supporting 4% or 9% Low-Income Housing Tax Credit applications is preferred.
* Familiarity with affordable housing financing and programs, including Low-Income Housing Tax Credits and RAD.
* Familiarity with development documents such as appraisals, property needs assessments, market studies, and environmental reports.
* Ability to organize detailed applications and records, track multiple deadlines, and prepare clear and accurate reports.
* Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and the ability to learn other systems used by the Authority.

**Working Conditions**  
Work is primarily performed in an office setting, with occasional visits to Authority properties, construction sites, and external meetings. Some work outside regular business hours may be required to meet project deadlines. The position may involve extended periods of sitting or standing and occasional lifting of up to 20 pounds. A valid driver’s license is required only if operating a vehicle is necessary to perform the position’s essential duties.

**BENEFITS**  

* Health insurance
* FREE Dental insurance
* FREE Vision insurance
* Life insurance
* Healthcare flexible spending account
* Dependent Care flexible spending account
* Commuter flexible spending account
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Paid time off including 14 Holidays
* Hybrid Schedule
* Flexible Work Hours
* 401(k) – Employer contribution of 6%

This job description is subject to change and in no manner states or implies that these are the only duties and responsibilities to be performed. The qualifications listed above are guidelines, other combinations of education and experience that could provide the necessary knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job will be considered.

jobs.title: Purchasing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Kirkland & Ellis**

At Kirkland & Ellis, we don’t just meet the standard for legal excellence — we set it. Our culture is built on teamwork, ingenuity and an unwavering commitment to continuous growth. We tackle the most sophisticated legal challenges with bold ideas and innovative solutions, powered by the exceptional experience and ambition of our 7,000+ people, including 4,000+ attorneys, across 24 offices worldwide. Our dedicated professionals share our lawyers’ commitment to excellence and show up each day to do meaningful work that helps drive global business, investment and innovation forward.

**What You’ll Do**

Are you a detail-oriented purchasing professional who enjoys keeping complex processes moving, solving issues, and partnering with teams and suppliers to get things done?

As a Purchasing Coordinator, you’ll support the firm’s end-to-end purchasing and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) function, helping ensure purchasing transactions are accurate, timely, and compliant with firm policies. From reviewing requisitions and managing purchase orders to resolving invoice issues and maintaining supplier records, you’ll serve as a key resource for internal stakeholders and external suppliers. You’ll also partner closely with Procurement Sourcing and Finance teams to maintain accurate purchasing data, address process issues, and identify opportunities to improve the P2P experience.  
  

* Purchasing & Purchase Order Administration: Review and approve purchase requisitions, purchase order (PO) changes, and PO invoices, ensuring requests align with supporting supplier documentation, payment terms, fee schedules, timelines, descriptions, amounts, and required approvals.
* P2P Monitoring & Compliance: Monitor automated reports and end-to-end P2P workflows to identify delays, errors, trends, or noncompliance, researching issues, enforcing purchasing policies, and coordinating escalations and resolution as needed.
* Supplier & Order Management: Confirm suppliers are accurately established and active within the appropriate systems, ensure approved POs and PO change requests are successfully transmitted, and work directly with suppliers to fulfill orders and resolve purchasing or invoicing issues.
* Invoice & Payment Support: Collaborate with Finance teams and suppliers to resolve invoice matching discrepancies and help ensure supplier invoices are processed accurately and efficiently for payment.
* Supplier Onboarding & Records: Partner with internal business users, suppliers, Purchasing team members, and the Sourcing team to support new supplier onboarding and maintain accurate, up-to-date supplier and contract information within the P2P system.
* Customer Service & Coordination: Manage the shared Purchasing inbox, including daily triage, responses, internal coordination, and supplier communications, while providing responsive support to stakeholders throughout the purchasing process.
* Card-Based Purchasing: Process Purchasing Card (P-Card) and/or Virtual Card (V-Card) order requests in partnership with Procurement’s Vendor Management team.
* Team & Process Support: Provide coverage for Purchasing Coordinators in other offices, identify and recommend opportunities to improve P2P processes, and support additional Purchasing team needs as assigned.

**What You’ll Bring**

* A bachelor’s degree in accounting or business, or equivalent experience along with a Purchasing Certification is required; 3+ years of purchasing or procurement experience required.
* Purchasing Experience: Three or more years of purchasing or procurement experience, with the ability to effectively support purchasing processes, stakeholders, and suppliers.
* Relationship & Customer Service Skills: Demonstrated ability to build effective relationships with internal stakeholders and suppliers, supported by strong interpersonal skills, sound judgment, and a service-oriented approach.
* Organization & Attention to Detail: Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage deadlines, prioritize competing responsibilities, and maintain accuracy in a dynamic environment, with availability to work overtime periodically as business needs require.
* Professional Judgment & Confidentiality: Ability to communicate professionally with firm staff and suppliers while appropriately safeguarding confidential client and firm information.
* Technology Skills: Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, web browsers, and P2P software solutions, along with a willingness to learn and grow as processes and technologies evolve.

If you’re excited to keep purchasing operations running smoothly, build strong partnerships, and make an impact across the Procure-to-Pay process, we’d love to hear from you for this Purchasing Coordinator opportunity!

**Compensation**

The base salary range below represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position in each of the below locations. This range may differ based on your geographic location and cost of living considerations. At Kirkland & Ellis, we consider compensation more than just a base salary. We offer an exceptional range of flexible benefits including comprehensive healthcare, paid time off, and retirement. We also offer personal support and tailored learning and development opportunities all designed to help you realize your full potential both in life and at work.

Compensation Range:

New York: $58,000 - $80,000

Thank you for your interest in Kirkland & Ellis LLP. To complete an application and submit your resume, please click "Apply Now."

AMA professionals receive comprehensive training, mentorship, and hands-on selling experience while supporting business development activities across the SMB organization. The AMA role offers a structured pathway into territory ownership through formal training, mentorship, and real-world sales experience designed to accelerate readiness for future Account Manager opportunities.

Account Manager I (AM I) professionals manage and grow an assigned customer portfolio, developing relationships, identifying solutions, and driving revenue growth through daily customer engagement.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Reports to:** Director, Customer Success  
**Location and Working Pattern:** New York Metro Preferred (Manhattan ideal), Hybrid/Flexible, Remote employment for the ideal candidate

**Department:** Sales

**Salary Range:** $145k-$175k OTE including base salary and variable commission

(Final compensation will be commensurate with experience and location)

**Who We Are**

QA is a global leader in technology and digital skills development, helping organizations build critical capabilities across AI, cloud, cybersecurity, data, software development, DevOps, digital transformation, leadership, and professional skills through instructor-led, virtual instructor-led, and digital learning solutions.

**Role Overview**

The Customer Success Manager serves as the primary customer success partner for a portfolio of mid-market and scaled customers. The role is responsible for driving customer adoption, retention, value realization, and overall customer health throughout the customer lifecycle. Working in partnership with Account Managers, the Customer Success Manager develops and executes customer success strategies that help customers achieve measurable business outcomes while identifying growth opportunities that can be advanced through Customer Success Qualified Leads (CSQLs). Success in this role requires a combination of customer success expertise, stakeholder management, program coordination, and scalable customer engagement capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer Lifecycle Management**

* Own customer onboarding, adoption, engagement, and value realization activities across an assigned portfolio.
* Develop and maintain customer success plans aligned to customer goals and business outcomes.
* Proactively identify customer risks and drive mitigation plans to improve retention and customer outcomes.
* Serve as the primary advocate for customer needs and objectives throughout the customer lifecycle.

**Customer Success & Retention**

* Drive ongoing customer adoption and utilization across QA learning solutions.
* Maintain a clear understanding of customer objectives, use cases, stakeholders, and success measures.
* Support renewal planning activities in partnership with assigned Account Managers.

**Joint Account Strategy & Planning**

* Partner closely with Account Managers to develop and execute account success strategies.
* Contribute customer insights, stakeholder intelligence, adoption trends, and risk assessments to account planning activities.
* Identify Customer Success Qualified Leads (CSQLs) and collaborate with Account Managers to advance growth opportunities.
* Align customer success activities to broader account objectives and customer business priorities.

**Program Coordination & Execution**

* Coordinate instructor-led training engagements and blended learning programs.
* Manage customer communications, milestones, action plans, and stakeholder alignment activities.
* Monitor program progress, identify delivery risks, and coordinate with internal teams to ensure successful execution and customer outcomes.

**Executive Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders across technology, learning and development, and business functions.
* Facilitate business reviews and outcome-focused customer discussions.
* Present recommendations, adoption insights, and success strategies to customer stakeholders.
* Navigate complex customer environments with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

**Scaled Customer Success & Adoption**

* Deliver one-to-many and one-to-few customer engagement activities, including webinars, office hours, enablement sessions, and adoption-focused campaigns.
* Use customer health indicators, engagement trends, lifecycle milestones, and success metrics to prioritize and execute digital customer success activities at scale.
* Gather customer feedback, identify recurring challenges, and implement scalable approaches that improve customer experience, adoption, and outcomes.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Gross Revenue Retention (GRR)
* Customer Success Qualified Leads (CSQLs)
* Customer Adoption and Engagement
* Verified Customer Outcomes
* Success Plan Completion
* Customer Advocacy, Reference Participation, and Business Review Completion

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

**Experience**

* 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Learning Services, Professional Services, or customer-facing consulting roles.
* Experience supporting instructor-led training, workforce development, learning services, or blended learning programs.
* Experience managing a portfolio of customer relationships and competing priorities.
* Experience delivering presentations, webinars, enablement sessions, and business reviews while coordinating across customer stakeholders and internal teams.
* Experience utilizing Salesforce and customer success platforms to manage customer engagement and lifecycle activities.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Data analysis, customer storytelling, and business outcome communication.
* Customer success planning and value realization.
* Strong stakeholder management, relationship-building, communication, and presentation skills.
* Program and project coordination.
* Experience leveraging Salesforce and customer success technologies.
* Strong organizational, time-management, and portfolio management skills.

**Why Join QA?**

Join QA and help shape the future of work for some of the world's most recognized organizations. Partner with leaders across technology, learning, and business functions to help customers close capability gaps, accelerate workforce transformation, and achieve measurable business outcomes.

jobs.description:
**Department**

BSD OBG - Lindau Lab - Operations

**About the Department**

The Lindau Laboratory at The University of Chicago is an interdisciplinary, team-based laboratory performing human-level observational, interventional, and health services research motivated by a fundamental concern for the principle of justice in health and health care. The lab, funded predominantly by agencies of the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services for more than 15 years, employs about 20 full and part-time researchers and staff across disciplines including epidemiology, gerontology, anthropology, neurobiology, cancer biology, public health, and data science. The lab routinely collaborates across disciplines, departments, and with investigators at other institutions including experts in the fields of computer science, geriatrics, oncology, public health, social services administration, psychology, neuroscience, materials science, engineering and other medical and social science fields. The work of the lab focuses in two main areas: 1) preservation and treatment of female sexual function in the context of aging, cancer and other common diseases and 2) social determinants of health, with a particular concern for women and older adults living in socioeconomically marginalized communities. Our research and programmatic activities include Bionic Breast, WomanLab, Feed1st and CommunityRx. The Lab has spun out two companies: Now Pow, LLC (acquired by Unite USA, Inc. in 2021) and MAPSCorps, 501c3 (joined Northwestern University School of Education and Social Policy in 2023), both originally headquartered in Hyde Park, Chicago, IL.

**Job Summary**

Reporting to the Director of Operations, this position supports the full range of Lindau Lab research operations and provides direct executive support to the Principal Investigator. Operational scope includes research participant and collaborator onboarding, human subjects compensation, procurement and contracts, human resources activities and SOP development, IT and facilities coordination, grant and funding opportunity support, financial and budget assistance, symposium and event coordination, and management of web and digital content for research dissemination. Executive support encompasses calendar management, maintenance of the PI’s biosketch and CV, conference and travel logistics, scientific presentation preparation, and research with Dr. Lindau and others in the lab on assigned special and other research projects.  
  
This at-will position is wholly or partially funded by contractual grant funding which is renewed under provisions set by the grantor of the contract. Employment will be contingent upon the continued receipt of these grant funds and satisfactory job performance.

**Responsibilities**

* Supports the Director of Operations across all aspects of lab research operations.
* Coordinates operational components of lab’s research projects, including but not limited to, research participant onboarding, human subjects compensation, research collaborator onboarding, procurement and contracts.
* Independently conducts human resources activities, including lab member onboarding and offboarding, and SOP development and update.
* Serves as a primary point of contact for lab IT and assists with other general operational needs including space, supplies, equipment and maintenance.
* Identifies, adapts and assists with implementation of AI tools, novel research operations methods and workflows across diverse study settings.
* Supports funding opportunity identification and analysis and the operational components of grant application and submission.
* Participates in the planning and coordination of the annual research symposium for the Bionic Breast Project and supports additional lab events and activities.
* Assists the Director of Operations, as needed, with lab financial management, grant budget development, operational coordination with subaward institutions, and other pre- and post-award grant administrative activities.
* Contributes to research dissemination activities through supporting the maintenance of the Lindau Lab website and other digital platforms.
* Provides direct support to the Principal Investigator to advance daily operational and research priorities. Liaises closely with Dr. Lindau's executive administrator in the university's Office of Research Management.
* Manages the PI’s calendar, biosketch, CV and related professional documentation.
* Coordinates meeting scheduling, conference attendance and itinerary preparation.
* Conducts literature search and synthesis for Dr. Lindau and supports special projects assigned by the PI and prepares and formats presentation materials.
* Support all activities of the Lindau Lab as needed to achieve success.
* Maintains technical and administrative support for a research project.
* Analyzes and maintains data and/or specimens. Conducts literature reviews. Assists with preparation of reports, manuscripts and other documents.
* Installs, sets up and performs experiments; interacting with students and other laboratory staff under the direction of the principal investigator.
* Maintains recruiting and scheduling research subjects; assisting with developing or amending study protocols; assisting with developing data collection tools; assisting with building databases; and providing general administrative support. Has general awareness in research techniques or methods, regulatory policies and procedures, and relevant scientific field.
* Performs other related work as needed.

8Fleet is hiring! We are a fast-growing technology and logistics company building the operational backbone for rideshare fleets, both driver-operated and autonomous. We run 24/7 operations with full-time drivers, a managed fleet of vehicles and a team that keeps it all moving. As we grow in Los Angeles, we are building out our local team.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an Operations Coordinator, based in Los Angeles, to keep our market running every day. You will keep driver shifts covered, vehicles assigned and ready, and the team working from the same information. When something breaks at 6 a.m., you are the person who already knows and is fixing it.

This is an on-site, hands-on role for someone who likes a fast pace, thinks in systems and enjoys being the person everyone relies on. You will work closely with Los Angeles market leadership and help build the processes and reporting the team uses as the market grows. Strong coordinators here grow into analyst and operations management roles.

SCHEDULE

Full-time, salaried, on-site in Los Angeles. This role supports a 24/7 operation, so some early mornings, evenings or weekends are expected.

* Own Daily Coverage: Build and manage driver schedules and shift coverage, fill gaps quickly and keep vehicles earning.

* Be the Operational Hub: Be the first point of contact for drivers and supervisors on day-to-day issues, and route what you cannot solve to the right owner fast.
* Run the Numbers: Track daily metrics such as coverage, utilization, attendance and vehicle status, and turn them into clear updates for leadership.

QUALIFICATIONS

* Clear, calm communication with drivers, teammates and leadership, especially when things go sideways.
* Flexibility to support a 24/7 operation, including some early mornings, evenings or weekends.

NICE TO HAVE

* Experience in rideshare, delivery, rental car or fleet operations.

* Experience launching a new market, site or operation.

WHY 8FLEET

* Help build the Los Angeles operation, not just run it.
* Clear paths into analyst and operations management roles as we scale.
* Medical, dental and vision, 401(k), paid time off and sick pay.

COMPENSATION

* $72,500 - $75,000 per year, plus equity

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

8Fleet is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

new_jobs.title: Production Coordinator (Starshield)
new_jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

**PRODUCTION COORDINATOR (STARSHIELD)**

Starshield leverages SpaceX's Starlink technology and launch capability to support national security efforts. While Starlink is designed for consumer and commercial use, Starshield is designed for government use, with an initial focus on three areas: Earth observation, communications, and hosted payloads. Designed to meet diverse mission requirements, Starshield satellites are capable of integrating a wide variety of payloads, offering unique versatility to users. With the proven ability to iterate rapidly, SpaceX's unique full-stack approach in developing end-to-end systems, from launch vehicles to user terminals, enables the deployment of capabilities at scale with unprecedented speed. Starshield's proliferated low-Earth orbit architecture provides inherent resiliency and constant connectivity to on-orbit assets, while SpaceX's proven rapid launch capability provides expedient and economical access to space.

The Production Coordinator is a linchpin position within our Starshield team. This role serves as a liaison between input and output organizations to ensure that components and assemblies flow smoothly through the production area and meet stringent deadlines and quality standards.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Monitor, track, and move parts as required through the production flow to ensure timely delivery to the next production location
* Coordinate the physical movement of parts through receiving inspection, stockrooms, purchasing, production resources, or any applicable work center within SpaceX
* Ensure parts are handled and protected properly and within SpaceX specifications
* Coordinate off-site processing of parts to ensure on-time delivery as required

* Manage material certifications as required, and prevent the use of uncertified materials
* Support production and inventory personnel with return-to-stock and inventory purge actions

* Support projects or productivity development activities within assigned production cells

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* High school diploma or equivalency certificate
* 1+ years of experience supporting administrative processes

**PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Strong computer skills and familiarity with the full Microsoft Office suite
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience organizing files and documents
* Knowledge of MRP/ERP systems
* Experience in aerospace, automotive, semiconductor, or electronics manufacturing environments
* SQL and Tableau experience
* APICS certification

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Must be willing to work all shifts, overtime, and/or weekends as needed. Estimated 1st shift hours: 5:00 a.m.–2:30 p.m.

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. We are looking for a Project Coordinator in Costa Mesa, CA to support project planning and execution by maintaining schedules, organising information, following up on outstanding tasks and keeping team members informed of progress.

You will work alongside project managers, department representatives and other stakeholders to help ensure that project activities are completed as planned. This position requires someone who is organised, communicates clearly and can manage several ongoing tasks without losing sight of deadlines or details.

* Assist project managers with preparing project schedules, timelines and task lists.

* Monitor progress against agreed timelines and bring potential delays or concerns to the project manager's attention.
* Support the preparation of status reports, presentations and progress summaries.
* Coordinate with internal departments, suppliers and external contacts when project activities require their input.
* Assist with administrative tasks related to project approvals, documentation and completion.
* Keep project files organised and ensure that important information is accessible to the team.

Experience and Qualifications

Previous experience in project coordination, project administration, operations support or a similar role is preferred.

You should have:

* Good organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.

* Familiarity with project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Asana, Trello, Monday.com or similar platforms.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, Outlook and PowerPoint.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.

A bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management or a related field is preferred. Equivalent work experience will also be considered.

The Project Coordinator will serve as an important point of contact for routine project communication and administrative follow-through. You will help project managers maintain visibility over deadlines, gather updates from team members and ensure that relevant documents are kept current.

new_jobs.title: DESIGNER AND PROJECT COORDINATOR
new_jobs.description:
**Olczak Group · Berkeley, CA · Full time, in office, 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM · $45 to $55 per hour**

Read this first. This role is in person at our Berkeley studio, five days a week, 8:30 to 5:30 with an hour for lunch. It is paid hourly. If that works for you, keep reading.

We are a licensed architecture practice and a licensed general contractor under one roof, with our own build team. Our work is high end residential in the Bay Area: ground up new homes, gut renovations, and remodels, with budgets that run into the millions. See our work at olczakgroup.com and olczakbuild.com. This seat is two jobs in one. You are the studio's Revit and visualization expert, producing the models, drawing sets, and images behind every project. You are also the coordinator who keeps project information moving so our Project Leads can lead. It is also the seat we promote from. Within your first year you will lead a small project of your own, such as a kitchen, a bath, or a backyard studio, with a Project Lead signing off at each gate.

**What you will do**

Design and production

* Build and maintain the Revit model for each project, from existing conditions through construction documents, under the direction of a Project Lead.
* Produce drawing sets that pass our written quality review the first time.
* Own the studio's Revit standards: templates, families, and the habits that keep models clean.
* Create the renderings and visualizations we use to present designs to clients.
* Contribute design work of your own: studies, options, and details.
* Measure and document existing conditions in the field.

Coordination

* Keep the logs current every day: submittals, RFIs, client selections, and bid tracking.
* Assemble bid packages from our templates, send them to subcontractors, chase the responses, and file them where they belong.
* Take meeting notes, turn them into action items the same day, and follow up until each one is closed.
* Track orders and lead times so nothing lands late on site.
* Support permit submittals: forms, sheets, and the response to comments.
* Keep project files organized to our written standard.

**What the work is really like**

This seat is about 65 percent design and production and 35 percent coordination, and both parts count. One day you are deep in a model. The next you are sending the third email and updating a log. People who want only to design will resent the follow up. People who want only to coordinate will not keep up in Revit. We are looking for the person who likes both, and who wants to run a project of their own.

**Who this fits**

* You hold a degree in architecture.
* You have five or more years of production experience in Revit, and you are the person others ask when a model breaks.
* You produce client ready renderings in V-Ray and Enscape, and your portfolio shows it.
* You have a designer's eye and can develop an idea into a buildable detail.
* You are organized in a way other people can see: your files, your notes, your inbox.
* You communicate before you are asked. If something will be late, we hear it from you first.

**What you get**

* $45 to $55 per hour, with overtime paid.
* A defined path. You lead your first small project within your first year, and we review your progress toward Designer Builder, the next seat up, at twelve months, against written criteria.
* Daily exposure to both design and construction, in the same room as the people doing each.
* Written standards for nearly everything you will be asked to do.
* PTO on accrual basis (per hour worked) for a maximum of 10 days per calendar year @ 40 hrs / week.
* Opportunities for continuing education in building science, architecture, materials, and detailing
* A positive work culture grounded in mutual respect, accountability, and integrity
* Employer subsidized healthcare benefits

**How to apply**

Email your resume and portfolio to careers@olczakgroup.com. The portfolio should include drawing sheets and renderings you produced yourself, with your role stated on each. Use the subject line "Designer and Project Coordinator" followed by your name, and tell us the earliest date you could start. In the body of the email, answer these two questions in 150 words or fewer each:

1.What is the most disorganized project or situation you have inherited, and what did you do first?

2.What is one system you built to keep track of things, and how do you know it works?

Applications without both answers will not be reviewed. Finalists complete a short paid Revit exercise.

Olczak Group is an equal opportunity employer.

Pay: $45.00 - $55.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance

Work Location: In person

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft Ads' vision is to build the largest transportation media network. We leverage media to elevate the transportation experience for our riders while building an exciting and sustainable advertising business. Our advertising opportunities include Lyft in-app homepage and in-ride products, off-platform audience extension retargeting, and IRL experiential executions. Our work is fun, challenging, and rewarding, and we're looking for someone who's excited to help grow our partnerships.

As an Account Manager, you'll report to the West Coast Account Management Lead and serve as a strategic partner to Account Executives on multiple books of advertiser and agency accounts. You'll own campaigns from pitch through wrap, act as the main day-to-day contact for clients post-sale, and work across Sales, Ad Ops, Product, Data, and other teams to deliver strong results. You'll also help improve the processes and tools our sales team relies on. We're looking for someone who loves solving interesting problems, works well with autonomy, and cares deeply about client success and growth.

---------------------

* BA/BS degree and 3-5 years of experience in digital advertising account management, media planning, or campaign management.

**About the role and team**  
  
Account Management at Uber means navigating ambiguity, earning trust fast, and solving problems that don’t come with a script. You’ll need to turn operational data into actionable growth strategies while moving with urgency to resolve technical blockers that impact the customer experience at scale. The Bay Club Operations Associate is an exciting opportunity to gain experience across multiple areas of Club operations while creating memorable experiences for members and guests every day. It's more than a support role; Associates contribute to the overall success of the Club by supporting hospitality, fitness, facility operations, and member services. This role provides a unique opportunity to explore different departments, build valuable skills, and discover potential career paths within the organization. This role is ideal for individuals who enjoy variety, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and are excited to develop new skills while building a foundation for future advancement. Bay Club Associates are expected to deliver outstanding service, uphold safety and cleanliness standards, support daily Club operations, and bring a positive, energetic, and professional attitude to every interaction.

  

**Our Culture**

Our unique culture is at the heart of all we do and is guided by our values and behaviors. It's what we expect of ourselves and each other every day. We call it our "Code of Culture".

Our Code of Culture includes Our Mantra, Our Actions We Live By, and Pete's Promise:

**Our Mantra:**

Respect The Past

Accept Responsibility

Pay it Forward

**Our Actions We Live By:**

**Actions We Live By**. It's who we are when we step into our full power.

**Keep It Real. Always.** We need open and honest discussions. We need courage to speak up and to call things out that aren't good enough. And we navigate tough conversations with empathy and grace.

**Think Ahead. Be An Owner**. Always be proactive, not reactive; be on the front foot. If we want to be an owner of this business, we must act like it!

**Stay Humble. Hustle Harder.** Show up and do the hard work. Be a gritty, roll-up-your-sleeves kind of crew. Know it's never about one person-we are a part of a powerful team.

**One Team. One Voice.** Be ONE united team. When we move in the same direction, there are no limits to what we can accomplish.

**Be Curious. Ask Why**. Stay member curious. We seek to understand, and we never settle. We ask questions to truly understand the core of a matter.

**Pete's Promise:**

Service Forward

Ruthlessly Consistent

Do the Right Thing

**Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.**

### **PRIMARY JOB FUNCTIONS**

### **Club Cleanliness & Housekeeping**

* Maintain cleanliness and appearance standards throughout assigned Club areas, including fitness spaces, locker rooms, lobby, reception desks, pool areas, restrooms, and common areas.
* Perform detail cleaning and preventive maintenance activities.
* Restock supplies, amenities, janitorial products, and inventory items.
* Assist with laundry operations, including collecting, washing, drying, and folding towels.
* Maintain a clean, safe, and organized work environment.
* Identify and communicate maintenance and cleanliness issues requiring further attention.

### **Customer Service & Member Experience**

* Greet members and guests upon arrival and throughout the Club.
* Check members and guests into the Club and applicable activity areas.
* Ensure guest registration requirements and applicable fees are completed.
* Book appointments, programs, services, and class reservations.
* Provide information regarding Club amenities, programming, events, and services.
* Deliver exceptional service experiences to members, guests, and fellow Associates.
* Build positive relationships with members and guests through proactive engagement and responsiveness.
